title.zh: 卷一百〇五 志第五十三: 刑法四
title.raw: 卷一百〇五 志第五十三: 刑法四 Volume 105 Treatises 58: Punishment and Law 4

sentences.zh: 刑法四 ○詐偽

translations.literal: Criminal Law IV ○ Fraud and Forgery
translations.idiomatic: Criminal Law IV — Fraud and Forgery

sentences.zh: 諸主謀偽造符寶，及受財鑄造者，皆處死。

translations.literal: All who mastermind forging seals and treasures, and those who receive payment to cast them, are all put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All who mastermind the forgery of imperial seals and treasures, and all who accept payment to cast them, shall be put to death.

sentences.zh: 同情轉募工匠，及受募刻字者，杖一百七。

translations.literal: Those who sympathetically recruit artisans on their behalf, and those hired to carve characters, receive 107 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: Those who knowingly recruit artisans on their behalf, and those hired to carve the inscriptions, shall receive 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 偽造制敕者，與符寶同。

translations.literal: Forging imperial decrees is treated the same as seals and treasures.
translations.idiomatic: Forging imperial decrees is punished the same as forging seals and treasures.

sentences.zh: 諸妄增減制書者，處死。

translations.literal: All who arbitrarily add to or reduce imperial edicts are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All who arbitrarily add to or subtract from imperial edicts shall be put to death.

sentences.zh: 諸近侍官輒詐傳上旨者，杖一百七，除名不敘。

translations.literal: All palace attendants who rashly falsely transmit the sovereign's intent receive 107 blows with the rod and are struck from rolls without reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: All palace attendants who falsely transmit the sovereign's intent shall receive 107 blows with the rod and be struck from the rolls without reinstatement.

sentences.zh: 諸偽造省府印信文字，但犯制敕者處死。

translations.literal: All who forge provincial or metropolitan office seals and documents, if they violate imperial decrees, are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All who forge provincial or metropolitan office seals and documents, if the offense involves imperial decrees, shall be put to death.

sentences.zh: 若偽造省府劄付者，杖一百七，再犯流遠。

translations.literal: If they forge provincial or metropolitan office memoranda, they receive 107 blows with the rod; on a second offense, exile to distant regions.
translations.idiomatic: If they forge provincial or metropolitan office memoranda, they shall receive 107 blows with the rod; on a second offense, they shall be exiled to distant regions.

sentences.zh: 知情不首者，八十七。

translations.literal: Those who know but do not report receive 87 blows.
translations.idiomatic: Those who know but fail to report shall receive 87 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 其文理訛謬不堪行用者，九十七。

translations.literal: If the text is so erroneous it cannot be used, 97 blows.
translations.idiomatic: If the text is so garbled that it cannot be used, the penalty is 97 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 若偽造司縣印信文字，追呼平民，勒取財物者，初犯杖七十七，累犯不悛者一百七。

translations.literal: If they forge prefectural or county seals and documents, summon commoners, and extort property: first offense 77 blows with the rod; if repeatedly offending without reform, 107 blows.
translations.idiomatic: If they forge prefectural or county seals and documents, summon commoners, and extort property: on a first offense, 77 blows with the rod; if they repeatedly offend without reform, 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸偽造宣慰司印信契本，及商稅務青由欺冒商賈者，杖一百七。

translations.literal: All who forge Pacification Commission seals and contract documents, or at commercial tax offices fraudulently deceive merchants with green permits, receive 107 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who forge Pacification Commission seals and contract documents, or who at commercial tax offices use green permits to defraud merchants, shall receive 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸赦前偽造省印，赦後不曾銷毀，杖七十七，有官者奪所受宣敕，除名不敘。

translations.literal: All who before an amnesty forged provincial seals and after the amnesty did not destroy them receive 77 blows; officials lose their received appointment edicts and are struck from rolls without reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: All who forged provincial seals before an amnesty and failed to destroy them afterward shall receive 77 blows with the rod; officials shall forfeit their appointment edicts and be struck from the rolls without reinstatement.

sentences.zh: 諸掾屬輒造省官押字，盜用省印，賣放官職者，雖會赦，流遠。

translations.literal: All clerks who forge provincial officials' signature marks, steal use of provincial seals, and sell official appointments, even if amnestied, are exiled to distant regions.
translations.idiomatic: All clerks who forge provincial officials' signature marks, steal the provincial seal, and sell official appointments shall, even if an amnesty applies, be exiled to distant regions.

sentences.zh: 諸偽造稅物雜印，私熬顏色，偽稅物貨者，杖八十七。

translations.literal: All who forge miscellaneous tax seals, privately brew dyes, and counterfeit taxed goods receive 87 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who forge miscellaneous tax seals, privately brew dyes, and counterfeit taxed goods shall receive 87 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 告捕得實者，征中統鈔一百貫充賞。

translations.literal: Accusers whose reports prove true receive 100 strings of Zhongtong paper money as reward.
translations.idiomatic: Accusers whose reports are verified shall receive 100 strings of Zhongtong paper money as reward.

sentences.zh: 物主知情，減犯人罪一等，其匿稅之物，一半沒官，於沒官物內一半付告人充賞；

translations.literal: If the owner knew, reduce the offender's crime by one grade; half the concealed goods are confiscated to the state, and half of the confiscated goods go to the accuser as reward;
translations.idiomatic: If the owner knew, the offender's crime is reduced by one grade; half the concealed goods are confiscated to the state, and half of what is confiscated is given to the accuser as reward;

sentences.zh: 不知情者不坐，物給元主。

translations.literal: If they did not know, they are not punished; goods are returned to the original owner.
translations.idiomatic: If they did not know, they are not punished, and the goods are returned to the original owner.

sentences.zh: 其捕獲人擅自脫放者，減犯人罪二等，受財者與犯人同罪。

translations.literal: If the captor arbitrarily releases the person, reduce the offender's crime by two grades; if bribed, same crime as the offender.
translations.idiomatic: If the captor arbitrarily releases the offender, the offender's crime is reduced by two grades; if the captor accepted a bribe, he is punished the same as the offender.

sentences.zh: 諸省部小史，為人誤毀行移檢紥，輒自刻印信，偽補署押，求蓋本罪，無他情弊者，杖七十七，發元籍。

translations.literal: All provincial and ministry petty clerks who, because someone accidentally destroyed their dispatch documents and inspection bundles, carve seals themselves and forge signatures to cover their original offense, with no other corruption, receive 77 blows and are sent to original registration.
translations.idiomatic: All provincial and ministry petty clerks who, because dispatch documents and inspection bundles were accidentally destroyed, carve seals themselves and forge signatures to cover their original offense, with no other corruption, shall receive 77 blows with the rod and be sent back to their original household registration.

sentences.zh: 諸僧道偽造諸王印信及令旨抄題者，處死。

translations.literal: All monks and Daoists who forge princely seals and transcriptions of commands are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All monks and Daoists who forge princely seals and transcriptions of commands shall be put to death.

sentences.zh: 諸盤獲偽造印信之人，同獲強盜給賞。

translations.literal: All who apprehend persons forging seals receive the same reward as for capturing robbers.
translations.idiomatic: All who apprehend persons forging seals shall receive the same reward as for capturing robbers.

sentences.zh: 諸告獲私造歷日者，賞銀一百兩。

translations.literal: All who report capture of privately made calendars receive 100 taels of silver reward.
translations.idiomatic: All who report the capture of privately made calendars shall receive a reward of 100 taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 如無太史院歷日印信，便同私歷造者，以違制論。

translations.literal: If there is no Astronomical Bureau calendar seal, it is treated the same as privately made calendars, prosecuted as violation of regulations.
translations.idiomatic: If there is no Astronomical Bureau calendar seal, it is treated the same as a privately made calendar and prosecuted as a violation of regulations.

sentences.zh: 諸受財賣他人敕牒，及收買轉賣者，杖一百七，刺面發元籍，買者杖八十七，發元籍。

translations.literal: All who receive payment to sell another's appointment edict, and those who purchase and resell, receive 107 blows with the rod, face tattooed, sent to original registration; buyers receive 87 blows, sent to original registration.
translations.idiomatic: All who accept payment to sell another's appointment edict, and all who purchase and resell such edicts, shall receive 107 blows with the rod, be tattooed on the face, and be sent back to their original registration; buyers shall receive 87 blows with the rod and be sent back to their original registration.

sentences.zh: 諸職官被差，以疾輒令人代乘驛傳而往者，杖六十七，代者笞五十七。

translations.literal: All officials on assignment who due to illness have another person substitute on post relay travel receive 67 blows; the substitute receives 57 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: All officials on assignment who, citing illness, have another person substitute on post relay travel shall receive 67 blows with the rod; the substitute shall receive 57 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸公差，於官船夾帶從人，冒支分例者，笞一十七，記過，支過分例來，追征還官。

translations.literal: All on official business who on government boats bring unauthorized attendants and falsely draw per diem receive 17 lashes, notation of offense, and drawn per diem is recovered for the state.
translations.idiomatic: All persons on official business who on government boats bring unauthorized attendants and falsely draw per diem shall receive 17 blows with the rod, have the offense noted on their record, and the per diem drawn shall be recovered for the state.

sentences.zh: 諸詐稱使臣，偽寫給驛文字，起馬匹舟船者，杖一百七。

translations.literal: All who falsely claim to be envoys, forge documents authorizing post relay, and requisition horses or boats receive 107 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who falsely claim to be envoys, forge documents authorizing post relay, and requisition horses or boats shall receive 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 有司失覺察，輒憑無印信關牒倒給者，判署官笞三十七，首領官吏四十七。

translations.literal: If officials fail to detect and issue relay supplies based on documents without seals: signing judge 37 lashes, chief clerks 47 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: If officials fail to detect this and issue relay supplies based on documents without seals, the signing judge shall receive 37 blows with the rod and the chief clerks 47 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸職官詐傳上司言語，擅起驛馬者，杖六十七。

translations.literal: All officials who falsely transmit a superior's words and arbitrarily requisition relay horses receive 67 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All officials who falsely transmit a superior's words and arbitrarily requisition relay horses shall receive 67 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 脫脫禾孫依隨擅給驛馬者，笞五十七，並解職別敘，記過；

translations.literal: Totoq who follows along and arbitrarily issues relay horses receives 57 lashes, is dismissed and reassigned elsewhere, notation of offense;
translations.idiomatic: Totoq who follows along and arbitrarily issues relay horses shall receive 57 blows with the rod, be dismissed and reassigned elsewhere, and have the offense noted on his record;

sentences.zh: 驛官二十七，還職。

translations.literal: The relay officer receives 27 lashes and is restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: the relay officer shall receive 27 blows with the rod and be restored to office.

sentences.zh: 諸詐稱按部官，恐嚇官吏者，杖六十七。

translations.literal: All who falsely claim to be touring inspection officials and intimidate officials receive 67 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who falsely claim to be touring inspection officials and intimidate officials shall receive 67 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸詐稱監臨長官署置差遣，欺取錢物者，杖八十七，錢物沒官。

translations.literal: All who falsely claim a supervising superior has dispatched them and fraudulently obtain money or goods receive 87 blows; money and goods are confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: All who falsely claim to have been dispatched by a supervising superior and fraudulently obtain money or goods shall receive 87 blows with the rod, and the money and goods shall be confiscated to the state.

sentences.zh: 諸詐稱奉使所委官，聽理民訟者，杖九十七。

translations.literal: All who falsely claim to be officials delegated by an imperial envoy and hear civil lawsuits receive 97 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who falsely claim to be officials delegated by an imperial envoy and hear civil lawsuits shall receive 97 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 詐稱隨行令史者，笞五十七。

translations.literal: Those who falsely claim to be accompanying clerks receive 57 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: Those who falsely claim to be accompanying clerks shall receive 57 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸偽造寶鈔，首謀起意，並雕板抄紙，收買顏料，書填字號，窩藏印造，但同情者皆處死，仍沒其家產。

translations.literal: All who forge treasure notes — ringleaders who conceived the plan, those who carve blocks and copy paper, purchase pigments, write and fill serial numbers, harbor and print — all who sympathize are put to death, and their household property is confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: All who forge treasure notes — ringleaders who conceived the plan, and all who carve blocks, copy paper, purchase pigments, write and fill serial numbers, or harbor and print them — all who knowingly participate shall be put to death, and their household property shall be confiscated.

sentences.zh: 兩鄰知而不首者，杖七十七。

translations.literal: Neighbors on both sides who know but do not report receive 77 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: Neighbors on both sides who know but fail to report shall receive 77 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 坊里正、主首、社長失覺察，並巡捕軍兵各笞四十七。

translations.literal: Ward heads, neighborhood chiefs, and community elders who fail to detect, and patrol soldiers each receive 47 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: Ward heads, neighborhood chiefs, and community elders who fail to detect the offense, and patrol soldiers, shall each receive 47 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 捕盜官及鎮守巡捕軍官各三十七，未獲賊徒，依強盜立限緝捕。

translations.literal: Robber-capture officials and garrison patrol officers each receive 37 lashes; if the criminals are not captured, pursue according to the robber time-limit for apprehension.
translations.idiomatic: Robber-capture officials and garrison patrol officers shall each receive 37 blows with the rod; if the criminals are not captured, they shall pursue them under the time limits set for robbers.

sentences.zh: 買使偽鈔者，初犯杖一百七，再犯加徒一年，三犯科斷流遠。

translations.literal: Those who purchase and use counterfeit notes: first offense 107 blows with the rod; second offense plus one year penal servitude; third offense sentenced to exile to distant regions.
translations.idiomatic: Those who purchase and use counterfeit notes: on a first offense, 107 blows with the rod; on a second offense, one year of penal servitude is added; on a third offense, they shall be sentenced to exile to distant regions.

sentences.zh: 諸捕獲偽鈔，賞銀五錠，給銀不給鈔。

translations.literal: All who capture counterfeit notes receive a reward of five ingots of silver; silver is given, not notes.
translations.idiomatic: All who capture counterfeit notes shall receive a reward of five ingots of silver; the reward is paid in silver, not in notes.

sentences.zh: 諸父子同造偽鈔者，皆處死。

translations.literal: All fathers and sons who jointly make counterfeit notes are all put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All fathers and sons who jointly manufacture counterfeit notes shall all be put to death.

sentences.zh: 諸父造偽鈔，子聽給使，不與父同坐；

translations.literal: All where the father makes counterfeit notes and the son merely follows and serves is not punished together with the father;
translations.idiomatic: If the father manufactures counterfeit notes and the son merely follows and serves him, the son is not punished together with the father;

sentences.zh: 子造偽鈔，父不同造，不與子同坐。

translations.literal: If the son makes counterfeit notes and the father did not jointly make them, the father is not punished together with the son.
translations.idiomatic: if the son manufactures counterfeit notes and the father did not jointly make them, the father is not punished together with the son.

sentences.zh: 諸夫偽造寶鈔者，妻不坐。

translations.literal: All where the husband forges treasure notes, the wife is not punished.
translations.idiomatic: If the husband forges treasure notes, the wife is not punished.

sentences.zh: 諸偽造寶鈔，印板不全者，杖一百七。

translations.literal: All who forge treasure notes with incomplete printing blocks receive 107 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who forge treasure notes with incomplete printing blocks shall receive 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸偽造寶鈔，沒其家產，不及其妻子。

translations.literal: All who forge treasure notes have their household property confiscated, not extending to wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: All who forge treasure notes shall have their household property confiscated, but the confiscation does not extend to their wives and children.

sentences.zh: 諸赦前收藏偽鈔，赦後行使者，杖一百七。

translations.literal: All who before an amnesty hoarded counterfeit notes and after the amnesty circulate them receive 107 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who hoarded counterfeit notes before an amnesty and circulate them afterward shall receive 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 不曾行使而不首者，減一等。

translations.literal: If they did not circulate them and do not confess, reduce by one grade.
translations.idiomatic: If they did not circulate them and fail to confess, the penalty is reduced by one grade.

sentences.zh: 諸偽造鈔罪應死者，雖親老無兼丁，不聽上請。

translations.literal: All whose counterfeiting offense warrants death, even if elderly parents lack another son, petition for commutation is not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: All whose counterfeiting offense warrants death shall not be permitted to petition for commutation, even if elderly parents lack another son to support them.

sentences.zh: 諸捕獲偽造寶鈔之人，雖已身故，其應得賞錢，仍給其親屬。

translations.literal: All who capture persons forging treasure notes, even if already deceased, the reward money due is still given to their relatives.
translations.idiomatic: All who capture persons forging treasure notes, even if the captor has already died, the reward due shall still be paid to his relatives.

sentences.zh: 諸奴婢買使偽鈔，其主陳首者，不在理賞之例。

translations.literal: All where slaves or servants purchase and use counterfeit notes, if the master confesses, is not within the rules for granting reward.
translations.idiomatic: If slaves or servants purchase and use counterfeit notes and the master confesses on their behalf, he is not eligible for reward.

sentences.zh: 諸挑剜裨輳寶鈔者，不分首從，杖一百七，徒一年，再犯流遠。

translations.literal: All who pick out, scrape, and patch together treasure notes, without distinguishing ringleader from follower, receive 107 blows with the rod and one year penal servitude; on a second offense, exile to distant regions.
translations.idiomatic: All who pick out, scrape, and patch together treasure notes, without distinguishing ringleader from follower, shall receive 107 blows with the rod and one year of penal servitude; on a second offense, they shall be exiled to distant regions.

sentences.zh: 年七十以上者，呈稟定奪，毋輒聽贖。

translations.literal: Those aged seventy or above shall have the case reported for decision; do not rashly permit redemption.
translations.idiomatic: Those aged seventy or above shall have the case reported for a ruling; redemption shall not be granted without authorization.

sentences.zh: 買使者減一等。

translations.literal: Purchasers and users are reduced by one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Purchasers and users are punished one grade lighter.

sentences.zh: 諸燒造偽銀者，徒。

translations.literal: All who smelt and manufacture counterfeit silver receive penal servitude.
translations.idiomatic: All who smelt and manufacture counterfeit silver shall be sentenced to penal servitude.

sentences.zh: 諸造賣偽銀，買主不知情，價錢給主，偽銀內銷，提真銀沒官，依本犯科罪。

translations.literal: All who manufacture and sell counterfeit silver: if the buyer did not know, the price is given to the owner, the counterfeit silver is melted down, the genuine silver extracted is confiscated, and punishment follows the original offense.
translations.idiomatic: All who manufacture and sell counterfeit silver: if the buyer did not know, the purchase price is returned to the seller, the counterfeit silver is melted down, any genuine silver extracted is confiscated to the state, and the offenders are punished according to the original offense.

sentences.zh: 諸偽造各倉支發糧籌者，笞五十七，已支出官糧者，準盜系官錢物科罪。

translations.literal: All who forge grain tally slips for disbursement from granaries receive 57 lashes; if official grain has already been disbursed, punish according to theft of government money and goods.
translations.idiomatic: All who forge grain tally slips for disbursement from granaries shall receive 57 blows with the rod; if official grain has already been disbursed, they shall be punished according to the law on theft of government money and goods.

sentences.zh: 倉官人等有犯者，依監主自盜法，贓重者從重論。

translations.literal: Granary officials who commit the offense are punished according to the law on supervisors who steal for themselves; if the stolen value is heavier, punish according to the heavier offense.
translations.idiomatic: Granary officials who commit the offense shall be punished according to the law on supervisors who steal for themselves; if the stolen value warrants a heavier penalty, the heavier penalty applies.

sentences.zh: 諸冒支官錢，計贓以枉法論，並除名不敘。

translations.literal: All who falsely draw official funds, calculating stolen value under perversion of law, and are struck from rolls without reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: All who falsely draw official funds shall, calculating the stolen value under the law on perversion of law, be struck from the rolls without reinstatement.

sentences.zh: 諸冒名入仕者，杖六十七，奪所受命，追俸發元籍，會赦不首，笞四十七，仍追奪之。

translations.literal: All who enter office under a false name receive 67 blows, lose their appointment, salary is recovered, sent to original registration; if amnestied and do not confess, 47 lashes, and appointment is still recovered.
translations.idiomatic: All who enter office under a false name shall receive 67 blows with the rod, forfeit their appointment, have their salary recovered, and be sent back to their original registration; if an amnesty applies and they fail to confess, they shall receive 47 blows with the rod and still forfeit the appointment.

sentences.zh: 諸奴受主命冒充職官者，杖九十七。

translations.literal: All slaves who on their master's orders impersonate officials receive 97 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All slaves who, on their master's orders, impersonate officials shall receive 97 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 其主及同僚相容隱者，八十七。

translations.literal: Their master and colleagues who knowingly conceal receive 87 blows.
translations.idiomatic: Their master and colleagues who knowingly conceal the offense shall receive 87 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸子冒父官居職任事者，杖七十七，犯在革前，革後不出首者，笞四十七，並追回所受宣敕，及支過俸祿還官。

translations.literal: All sons who usurp their father's office and hold duties receive 77 blows; if the offense was before a reform and they do not confess after the reform, 47 lashes, and received appointment edicts and drawn salary are recovered for the state.
translations.idiomatic: All sons who usurp their father's office and perform its duties shall receive 77 blows with the rod; if the offense occurred before a reform and they fail to confess afterward, they shall receive 47 blows with the rod, and their appointment edicts and drawn salary shall be recovered for the state.

sentences.zh: 諸邊臣，輒以子婿詐稱招徠蠻獠，保充土官者，除名不敘，拘奪所授官。

translations.literal: All frontier officials who rashly have sons-in-law falsely claim to recruit barbarian tribes and guarantee them as native officials are struck from rolls without reinstatement and have conferred offices seized.
translations.idiomatic: All frontier officials who have sons-in-law falsely claim to recruit tribal peoples and guarantee them as native officials shall be struck from the rolls without reinstatement and have their conferred offices seized.

sentences.zh: 諸軍官承襲，偽增年者，監察御史廉訪司糾察之，濫保官吏，並坐罪。

translations.literal: All military officers inheriting posts who falsely inflate age are investigated by censorial and surveillance commissioners; officials who recklessly guarantee them are punished together.
translations.idiomatic: All military officers inheriting posts who falsely inflate their age shall be investigated by censorial and surveillance commissioners; officials who recklessly vouch for them shall be punished together.

sentences.zh: 諸職官妄報出身履歷者，除名不敘。

translations.literal: All officials who falsely report origin and career history are struck from rolls without reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: All officials who falsely report their origin and career history shall be struck from the rolls without reinstatement.

sentences.zh: 諸譯史、令史，有過不敘。

translations.literal: All translators and clerks with offenses are not reinstated.
translations.idiomatic: All translators and clerks with offenses on their record shall not be reinstated.

sentences.zh: 詐稱作闕，別處補用者，笞五十七，罷役不敘。

translations.literal: Those who falsely claim a vacancy and are appointed elsewhere receive 57 lashes, dismissed from service without reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: Those who falsely claim a vacancy and are appointed elsewhere shall receive 57 blows with the rod, be dismissed from service, and not be reinstated.

sentences.zh: 諸輸納官物，輒增改朱鈔者，杖六十七，罷之。

translations.literal: All who when submitting official goods rashly alter the red tally receive 67 blows and are dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: All who, when submitting official goods, rashly alter the red tally shall receive 67 blows with the rod and be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 諸有司長官，輒以追到盜贓支使，卻虛立給主文案者，雖會赦，解職，降先職二等敘。

translations.literal: All department heads who rashly use recovered stolen goods for expenses yet falsely create documents returning them to owners, even if amnestied, are dismissed and reinstated two grades below former rank.
translations.idiomatic: All department heads who rashly use recovered stolen goods for expenses yet falsely create documents showing they were returned to the owners shall, even if an amnesty applies, be dismissed and reinstated two grades below their former rank.

sentences.zh: 承吏，除名不敘。

translations.literal: The handling clerk is struck from rolls without reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: The handling clerk shall be struck from the rolls without reinstatement.

sentences.zh: 諸帥府上功文字，詐添有功軍人名數，主謀者杖八十七，除名不敘，隨從書寫者笞五十七。

translations.literal: All who in commandery headquarters merit reports falsely add names of meritorious soldiers: ringleaders receive 87 blows and are struck from rolls without reinstatement; followers who wrote receive 57 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: All who in commandery headquarters merit reports falsely add names of meritorious soldiers: ringleaders shall receive 87 blows with the rod and be struck from the rolls without reinstatement; followers who wrote the documents shall receive 57 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸詐以軍功受舉入仕者，罷之，仍奪所受命。

translations.literal: All who by false military merit receive recommendation to enter office are dismissed and still lose their appointment.
translations.idiomatic: All who enter office through falsely claimed military merit shall be dismissed and forfeit their appointment.

sentences.zh: 諸擅改已奏官員選目姓名者，雖會赦，除名發元籍。

translations.literal: All who without authorization alter names on submitted official selection lists, even if amnestied, are struck from rolls and sent to original registration.
translations.idiomatic: All who without authorization alter names on submitted official selection lists shall, even if an amnesty applies, be struck from the rolls and sent back to their original registration.

sentences.zh: 諸曹吏輒於公牘改易年月，圖逭罪責者，笞五十七，罷役別敘，記過。

translations.literal: All department clerks who rashly alter year and month on official documents to evade culpability receive 57 lashes, dismissed from service and reassigned elsewhere, notation of offense.
translations.idiomatic: All department clerks who rashly alter dates on official documents to evade culpability shall receive 57 blows with the rod, be dismissed from service and reassigned elsewhere, and have the offense noted on their record.

sentences.zh: 諸嘩強之人，輒為人偽增籍面者，杖八十七，紅泥粉壁識過其門。

translations.literal: All violent and overbearing persons who rashly forge additions to household registers for others receive 87 blows; red clay is smeared on the wall to mark the offense at their gate.
translations.idiomatic: All violent and overbearing persons who rashly forge additions to household registers for others shall receive 87 blows with the rod, and red clay shall be smeared on the wall to mark the offense at their gate.

sentences.zh: 諸蒙古譯史，能辨出詐偽文字二起以上者，減一資升轉。

translations.literal: All Mongol translators who can identify two or more cases of fraudulent documents receive one grade reduction in promotion.
translations.idiomatic: All Mongol translators who identify two or more cases of fraudulent documents shall be promoted one grade sooner.

sentences.zh: ○訴訟

translations.literal: ○ Litigation
translations.idiomatic: Litigation

sentences.zh: 諸告人罪者，須明註年月，指陳實事，不得稱疑。

translations.literal: All who accuse others of crimes must clearly note year and month, point out actual facts, and must not speak in terms of suspicion.
translations.idiomatic: All who accuse others of crimes must clearly state the year and month, specify actual facts, and must not speak in terms of mere suspicion.

sentences.zh: 誣告者抵罪反坐，越訴者笞五十七。

translations.literal: False accusers bear the crime in reverse punishment; those who appeal beyond proper jurisdiction receive 57 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: False accusers shall bear the crime through reverse punishment; those who appeal beyond proper jurisdiction shall receive 57 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 本屬官司有過，及有冤抑，屢告不理，或理斷偏屈，並應合回避者，許赴上司陳之。

translations.literal: If the original jurisdiction has faults, or there is wrongful suppression, repeated petitions go unanswered, or judgment is partial and unjust, and cases where recusal is required, they are permitted to petition a superior.
translations.idiomatic: If the original jurisdiction is at fault, if there is wrongful suppression, if repeated petitions go unanswered, if judgment is partial and unjust, or if recusal is required, petitioners are permitted to appeal to a superior authority.

sentences.zh: 諸訴訟本爭事外，別生余事者，禁。

translations.literal: All litigation: beyond the matter in dispute, raising other matters is forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In all litigation, raising matters beyond the dispute at issue is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 其本爭事畢，別訴者聽。

translations.literal: If the matter in dispute is concluded, separate suits are permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Once the matter in dispute is concluded, separate suits are permitted.

sentences.zh: 諸軍民風憲官有罪，各從其所屬上司訴之。

translations.literal: All military and civilian censorial officials who commit crimes each appeal through their respective superiors.
translations.idiomatic: All military and civilian censorial officials who commit crimes shall each appeal through their respective superiors.

sentences.zh: 諸民間雜犯，赴有司陳首者聽。

translations.literal: All minor civilian offenses, those who go to officials to confess are permitted.
translations.idiomatic: For all minor civilian offenses, those who go to officials to confess voluntarily are permitted to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸告言重事實，輕事虛，免坐；

translations.literal: All who report heavy matters truthfully but light matters falsely are exempt from punishment;
translations.idiomatic: All who report serious matters truthfully but minor matters falsely shall be exempt from punishment;

sentences.zh: 輕事實，重事虛，反坐。

translations.literal: Light matters truthfully but heavy matters falsely, reverse punishment.
translations.idiomatic: if minor matters are true but serious matters are false, reverse punishment applies.

sentences.zh: 諸中外有司，發人家錄私書，輒興獄訟者，禁之。

translations.literal: All central and local officials who search households and copy private writings and rashly initiate lawsuits are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All central and local officials who search households, copy private writings, and rashly initiate lawsuits are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 若本宗事須引用證驗者，仍聽追照。

translations.literal: If the original case requires citation and verification, they are still permitted to pursue and examine.
translations.idiomatic: If the original case requires citation and verification, officials are still permitted to pursue and examine the documents.

sentences.zh: 其構飾傅會，以文致人罪者，審辨之。

translations.literal: Those who fabricate and connect matters, using documents to cause others' guilt, shall be carefully distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Those who fabricate and connect matters, using documents to implicate others, shall be carefully distinguished and judged.

sentences.zh: 除本宗外，余事並勿聽理。

translations.literal: Apart from the original case, other matters are all not to be heard.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from the original case, no other matters shall be heard.

sentences.zh: 諸教令人告緦麻以上親，及奴婢告主者，各減告者罪一等。

translations.literal: All who instruct others to accuse relatives within mourning dress or above, and slaves or servants who accuse masters, each reduce the accuser's crime by one grade.
translations.idiomatic: All who instruct others to accuse relatives within the mourning circle or closer, and slaves or servants who accuse their masters, shall each have the accuser's crime reduced by one grade.

sentences.zh: 若教令人告子孫，各減所告罪二等。

translations.literal: If instructing others to accuse descendants, each reduces the accused crime by two grades.
translations.idiomatic: If someone instructs another to accuse his descendants, the instructed accuser's crime is reduced by two grades.

sentences.zh: 其教令人告事虛應反坐，或得實應賞者，皆以告者為首，教令為從。

translations.literal: If instructing others to accuse falsely warrants reverse punishment, or if verified warrants reward, in all cases the accuser is principal and the instructor is follower.
translations.idiomatic: If an instructed accusation proves false and warrants reverse punishment, or if it proves true and warrants reward, in all cases the accuser is treated as principal and the instructor as follower.

sentences.zh: 諸老廢篤疾，事須爭訴，止令同居親屬深知本末者代之。

translations.literal: All elderly, disabled, or seriously ill persons who must litigate are only permitted to have co-residing relatives who thoroughly know the facts act in their place.
translations.idiomatic: All elderly, disabled, or seriously ill persons who must litigate may only have co-residing relatives who thoroughly know the facts act in their place.

sentences.zh: 若謀反大逆，子孫不孝，為同居所侵侮，必須自陳者聽。

translations.literal: If treason or great rebellion, unfilial descendants, or co-residents being invaded and insulted require personal statement, it is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: If the case involves treason or great rebellion, unfilial descendants, or co-residents being invaded and insulted, personal appearance is permitted when necessary.

sentences.zh: 諸致仕得代官，不得已與齊民訟，許其親屬家人代訴，所司毋侵撓之。

translations.literal: All retired officials entitled to replacement rank who unavoidably sue commoners are permitted to have relatives or household members sue on their behalf; officials must not harass them.
translations.idiomatic: All retired officials entitled to replacement rank who unavoidably sue commoners are permitted to have relatives or household members sue on their behalf; officials must not harass or interfere with them.

sentences.zh: 諸婦人輒代男子告辨爭訟者，禁之。

translations.literal: All women who rashly substitute for men in filing and arguing lawsuits are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All women who rashly substitute for men in filing and arguing lawsuits are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 若果寡居，及雖有子男，為他故所妨，事須爭訟者，不在禁例。

translations.literal: If truly widowed, or though having sons, obstructed by other causes and litigation is necessary, they are not within the prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: If a woman is truly widowed, or though she has sons is obstructed by other causes and must litigate, she is not subject to the prohibition.

sentences.zh: 諸子證其父，奴訐其主，及妻妾弟侄不相容隱，凡幹名犯義，為風化之玷者，並禁止之。

translations.literal: All sons who testify against fathers, slaves who accuse masters, and wives, concubines, younger brothers, and nephews who do not conceal for one another — all that offend names and violate righteousness, staining custom — are all forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All sons who testify against their fathers, slaves who accuse their masters, and wives, concubines, younger brothers, and nephews who fail to conceal offenses for one another — all conduct that offends propriety, violates righteousness, and stains public morals — is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸親屬相告，並同自首。

translations.literal: All relatives who accuse one another are treated the same as voluntary confession.
translations.idiomatic: All relatives who accuse one another shall be treated the same as voluntary confession.

sentences.zh: 諸妻訐夫惡，比同自首原免。

translations.literal: All wives who expose husbands' wrongs are treated the same as voluntary confession and originally exempted.
translations.idiomatic: All wives who expose their husbands' wrongs shall be treated the same as voluntary confession and originally exempted from punishment.

sentences.zh: 凡夫有罪，非惡逆重事，妻得相容隱，而輒告訐其夫者，笞四十七。

translations.literal: All ordinary husbands who commit crimes, not grave treasonous matters, wives may conceal for them, but those who rashly accuse and expose their husbands receive 47 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: For ordinary husbands who commit crimes short of grave treason, wives may conceal the offense; but those who rashly accuse and expose their husbands shall receive 47 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸妻曾背夫而逃，被斷復誣告其夫以重罪者，抵罪反坐，從其夫嫁賣。

translations.literal: All wives who once fled against their husbands, were judged, and again falsely accuse their husbands of grave crimes bear the crime in reverse punishment and follow their husbands in being sold in remarriage.
translations.idiomatic: All wives who once fled from their husbands, were judged, and again falsely accuse their husbands of grave crimes shall bear the crime through reverse punishment and be sold in remarriage at their husbands' direction.

sentences.zh: 諸職官同僚相言者，並解職別敘，記過。

translations.literal: All officials who accuse colleagues are all dismissed and reassigned elsewhere, notation of offense.
translations.idiomatic: All officials who accuse their colleagues shall be dismissed, reassigned elsewhere, and have the offense noted on their record.

sentences.zh: 諸告人罪者，自下而上，不得越訴。

translations.literal: All who accuse others of crimes must proceed from below to above and must not appeal beyond jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: All who accuse others of crimes must proceed from lower to higher authority and must not appeal beyond proper jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 諸府州司縣應受理而不受理，雖受理而聽斷偏屈，或遷延不決者，隨輕重而罪罰之。

translations.literal: All prefectures, districts, departments, and counties that should accept cases but do not, or though accepting hear partial and unjust judgment, or delay without decision, are punished according to severity.
translations.idiomatic: All prefectures, districts, departments, and counties that should accept cases but fail to do so, or that though accepting cases render partial and unjust judgments, or delay without decision, shall be punished according to the severity of the offense.

sentences.zh: 諸訴官吏受賂不法，徑赴憲司者，不以越訴論。

translations.literal: All who sue officials for taking bribes and acting unlawfully and go directly to the censorial office are not treated as appealing beyond jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: All who sue officials for taking bribes and acting unlawfully and go directly to the censorial office shall not be treated as having appealed beyond jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 諸陳訴有理，路府州縣不行，訴之省部臺院，省部臺院不行，經乘輿訴之。

translations.literal: All who present petitions with reason, if circuit, prefecture, district, and county do not act, appeal to ministries, departments, censorates, and courts; if ministries, departments, censorates, and courts do not act, appeal through the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: All who present petitions with merit, if circuit, prefecture, district, and county authorities do not act, may appeal to the ministries, departments, censorates, and courts; if those bodies do not act, they may appeal through the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 未訴省部臺院，輒經乘輿訴者，罪之。

translations.literal: Those who without first appealing to ministries, departments, censorates, and courts rashly appeal through the imperial carriage are punished.
translations.idiomatic: Those who without first appealing to the ministries, departments, censorates, and courts rashly appeal through the imperial carriage shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 諸職官誣告人枉法贓者，以其罪罪之，除名不敘。

translations.literal: All officials who falsely accuse others of perverting law and taking bribes are punished with that crime and struck from rolls without reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: All officials who falsely accuse others of perverting the law and taking bribes shall be punished with that crime and struck from the rolls without reinstatement.

sentences.zh: 諸奴婢誣告其主者處死，本主求免者，聽減一等。

translations.literal: All slaves or servants who falsely accuse their masters are put to death; if the master seeks exemption, permit reduction by one grade.
translations.idiomatic: All slaves or servants who falsely accuse their masters shall be put to death; if the master seeks exemption, the penalty may be reduced by one grade.

sentences.zh: 諸以奴告主私事，主同自首，奴杖七十七。

translations.literal: All where a slave reports the master's private matters, the master is treated the same as voluntary confession; the slave receives 77 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: If a slave reports his master's private matters, the master shall be treated the same as having made a voluntary confession; the slave shall receive 77 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: ○鬥毆

translations.literal: ○ Affray
translations.idiomatic: Affray

sentences.zh: 諸鬥毆，以手足擊人傷者，笞二十七，以他物者三十七。

translations.literal: All affray: striking a person with hands or feet causing injury receives 27 lashes; with other objects, 37 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: In all affray, striking a person with hands or feet and causing injury shall receive 27 blows with the rod; with other objects, 37 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 傷及拔發方寸以上，四十七。

translations.literal: Injury including pulling out hair more than one inch square, 47 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: If the injury includes pulling out hair over one inch square, the penalty is 47 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 若血從耳目出及內損吐血者，加一等。

translations.literal: If blood flows from ears or eyes or internal injury causes vomiting blood, add one grade.
translations.idiomatic: If blood flows from the ears or eyes, or internal injury causes vomiting of blood, the penalty is increased by one grade.

sentences.zh: 折齒、毀缺耳鼻、眇一目及折手足指，若破骨及湯火傷人者，杖六十七。

translations.literal: Breaking teeth, mutilating nose or ears, blinding one eye, breaking hand, foot, or fingers, breaking bones, or scalding or burning a person receive 67 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: Breaking teeth, mutilating the nose or ears, blinding one eye, breaking a hand, foot, or fingers, breaking bones, or scalding or burning a person shall receive 67 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 折二齒二指以上，及髡發，並刃傷、折人肋、眇人兩目、墮人胎，七十七。

translations.literal: Breaking two teeth or two fingers or more, shaving the head, blade wounds, breaking someone's ribs, blinding both eyes, causing miscarriage — 77 blows.
translations.idiomatic: Breaking two teeth or two fingers or more, shaving the head, blade wounds, breaking someone's ribs, blinding both eyes, or causing miscarriage — the penalty is 77 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 以穢物汙人頭面者，罪亦如之。

translations.literal: Defiling a person's head or face with filth is punished the same.
translations.idiomatic: Defiling a person's head or face with filth is punished the same way.

sentences.zh: 折跌人肢體，及瞎其目者，九十七。

translations.literal: Breaking or disabling a person's limbs, or blinding the eyes, receives 97 blows.
translations.idiomatic: Breaking or disabling a person's limbs, or blinding the eyes, shall receive 97 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 辜內平復者，各減二等。

translations.literal: If recovery occurs within the grace period, each is reduced by two grades.
translations.idiomatic: If recovery occurs within the grace period, each penalty is reduced by two grades.

sentences.zh: 即損二事以上，及因舊患，令至篤疾，若斷舌及毀敗人陰陽者，一百七。

translations.literal: If two or more injuries, or because of old illness leading to grave disability, or cutting out the tongue or destroying a person's reproductive organs — 107 blows.
translations.idiomatic: If there are two or more injuries, or an old illness leads to grave disability, or the tongue is cut out or a person's reproductive organs are destroyed — the penalty is 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸訴毆詈，有闌告者勿聽，違者究之。

translations.literal: All lawsuits of assault and abuse: if there is an intrusive accuser, do not hear; violators are investigated.
translations.idiomatic: In all lawsuits of assault and abuse, intrusive accusers shall not be heard; violators shall be investigated.

sentences.zh: 諸保辜者，手足毆傷人，限十日。

translations.literal: All subject to grace period: hand and foot assault on a person, limit ten days.
translations.idiomatic: For all subject to the grace period: assault with hands or feet, the limit is ten days.

sentences.zh: 以他物毆傷者，二十日。

translations.literal: Assault with other objects, twenty days.
translations.idiomatic: Assault with other objects, the limit is twenty days.

sentences.zh: 以刃及湯火傷人者，三十日，折跌肢體及破骨者，五十日。

translations.literal: Injury with blade or scalding or burning, thirty days; breaking or disabling limbs and breaking bones, fifty days.
translations.idiomatic: Injury with a blade or by scalding or burning, the limit is thirty days; breaking or disabling limbs or breaking bones, the limit is fifty days.

sentences.zh: 毆傷不相須，余條毆傷，及殺傷者準此。

translations.literal: Assault injuries need not be cumulative; other articles on assault injury and killing injury follow this.
translations.idiomatic: Assault injuries need not be cumulative; other articles on assault injury and killing injury follow this rule.

sentences.zh: 限內死者，各依殺人論。

translations.literal: If death occurs within the limit, each is judged according to homicide.
translations.idiomatic: If death occurs within the limit, each offender is judged according to the law on homicide.

sentences.zh: 其在限外，及雖在限內，以他故死者，各依本毆傷法。

translations.literal: If outside the limit, or though within the limit death occurs from other causes, each follows the original assault injury law.
translations.idiomatic: If death occurs outside the limit, or though within the limit from other causes, each offender is judged according to the original assault injury law.

sentences.zh: 他故，謂別增余患而死者。

translations.literal: Other causes means death from separately added additional illness.
translations.idiomatic: Other causes means death from a separately added illness.

sentences.zh: 諸倡女鬥傷良人，辜限之外死者，杖七十七，單衣受刑。

translations.literal: All where a courtesan in affray injures a commoner and he dies outside the grace period limit, receive 77 blows with the rod, punished in single garment.
translations.idiomatic: If a courtesan in affray injures a commoner and he dies outside the grace period, she shall receive 77 blows with the rod and be punished wearing only a single garment.

sentences.zh: 諸毆傷人，辜限外死者，杖七十七。

translations.literal: All who assault and injure a person and he dies outside the grace period limit receive 77 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who assault and injure a person and he dies outside the grace period shall receive 77 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸以非理毆傷妻妾者，罪以本毆傷論，並離之。

translations.literal: All who without justification assault and injure wives or concubines are punished according to the original assault injury and are also divorced.
translations.idiomatic: All who without justification assault and injure wives or concubines shall be punished according to the basic assault injury law and shall also be divorced from them.

sentences.zh: 若妻不為父母悅，以致非理毆傷者，罪減三等，仍離之。

translations.literal: If the wife displeases the parents and this leads to unjustified assault and injury, the crime is reduced by three grades, and divorce still applies.
translations.idiomatic: If the wife displeases her parents-in-law and this leads to unjustified assault and injury, the crime is reduced by three grades, but divorce still applies.

sentences.zh: 諸職官毆妻墮胎者，笞三十七，解職，期年後降先品一等，註邊遠一任，妻離之。

translations.literal: All officials who assault their wives causing miscarriage receive 37 lashes, are dismissed, after one year reinstated one grade below former rank, assigned one term in a remote region, and divorced from the wife.
translations.idiomatic: All officials who assault their wives causing miscarriage shall receive 37 blows with the rod, be dismissed, after one year be reinstated one grade below their former rank and assigned one term in a remote region, and be divorced from the wife.

sentences.zh: 諸以非理苦虐未成婚男婦者，笞四十七，婦歸宗，不追聘財。

translations.literal: All who without justification cruelly abuse an unmarried daughter-in-law receive 47 lashes; the woman returns to her clan; betrothal gifts are not recovered.
translations.idiomatic: All who without justification cruelly abuse an unmarried daughter-in-law shall receive 47 blows with the rod; the woman shall return to her clan, and betrothal gifts shall not be recovered.

sentences.zh: 諸舅姑非理陵虐無罪男婦者，笞四十七，男婦歸宗，不追聘財。

translations.literal: All parents-in-law who without justification tyrannize an innocent unmarried daughter-in-law receive 47 lashes; the daughter-in-law returns to her clan; betrothal gifts are not recovered.
translations.idiomatic: All parents-in-law who without justification tyrannize an innocent unmarried daughter-in-law shall receive 47 blows with the rod; the daughter-in-law shall return to her clan, and betrothal gifts shall not be recovered.

sentences.zh: 諸蒙古人與漢人爭，毆漢人，漢人勿還報，許訴於有司。

translations.literal: All where Mongols dispute with Han Chinese and beat Han Chinese, Han Chinese must not retaliate; they are permitted to sue before officials.
translations.idiomatic: When Mongols dispute with Han Chinese and beat Han Chinese, the Han Chinese must not retaliate; they are permitted to sue before the authorities.

sentences.zh: 諸蒙古人斫傷他人奴，知罪願休和者聽。

translations.literal: All where Mongols hack and injure another's slave, if they know the crime and wish to settle peacefully, it is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: If Mongols hack and injure another's slave, and knowing their guilt they wish to settle peacefully, settlement is permitted.

sentences.zh: 諸以他物傷人，致成廢疾者，杖七十七，仍追中統鈔一十錠，付被傷人，充養濟之資。

translations.literal: All who with other objects injure a person causing permanent disability receive 77 blows with the rod, and still collect ten ingots of Zhongtong paper money paid to the injured person as support funds.
translations.idiomatic: All who with other objects injure a person causing permanent disability shall receive 77 blows with the rod, and ten ingots of Zhongtong paper money shall still be collected and paid to the injured person as support funds.

sentences.zh: 諸因鬥毆，斫傷人成廢疾者，杖八十七，征中統鈔一十錠，付被傷人，充養濟之資。

translations.literal: All who in affray hack and injure a person causing permanent disability receive 87 blows with the rod; ten ingots of Zhongtong paper money are collected and paid to the injured person as support funds.
translations.idiomatic: All who in affray hack and injure a person causing permanent disability shall receive 87 blows with the rod; ten ingots of Zhongtong paper money shall be collected and paid to the injured person as support funds.

sentences.zh: 為父還毆致傷者，征其鈔之半。

translations.literal: If injury results from retaliatory beating for one's father, collect half the paper money.
translations.idiomatic: If injury results from retaliatory beating on one's father's behalf, half the paper money shall be collected.

sentences.zh: 諸豪橫輒誣平人為盜，捕其夫婦男女，於私家拷訊監禁，非理陵虐者，杖一百七，流遠。

translations.literal: All violent and overbearing persons who rashly falsely accuse commoners of theft, capture their husbands, wives, and children, privately torture and imprison them, and tyrannize without justification receive 107 blows with the rod and exile to distant regions.
translations.idiomatic: All violent and overbearing persons who rashly falsely accuse commoners of theft, capture their husbands, wives, and children, privately torture and imprison them, and tyrannize them without justification shall receive 107 blows with the rod and be exiled to distant regions.

sentences.zh: 其被害有致殘廢者，人征中統鈔二十錠，充養贍之貲。

translations.literal: If the victim suffers permanent disability, collect twenty ingots of Zhongtong paper money per person as support funds.
translations.idiomatic: If the victim suffers permanent disability, twenty ingots of Zhongtong paper money per person shall be collected as support funds.

sentences.zh: 諸職官輒將養男去勢，以充閹官進納者，杖一百七，除名不敘，記過，義男歸宗。

translations.literal: All officials who rashly castrate foster sons to supply eunuch officials for presentation receive 107 blows with the rod, are struck from rolls without reinstatement, notation of offense, and foster sons return to their clans.
translations.idiomatic: All officials who rashly castrate foster sons to supply eunuch officials for presentation shall receive 107 blows with the rod, be struck from the rolls without reinstatement, have the offense noted on their record, and the foster sons shall return to their clans.

sentences.zh: 諸以微故殘傷義男肢體廢疾者，加凡人折跌肢體一等論，義男歸宗，仍征中統鈔五百貫，充養贍之貲。

translations.literal: All who for trivial cause mutilate foster sons' limbs causing permanent disability are judged one grade heavier than commoners who break or disable limbs; foster sons return to their clans; still collect 500 strings of Zhongtong paper money as support funds.
translations.idiomatic: All who for a trivial cause mutilate foster sons' limbs causing permanent disability shall be judged one grade heavier than commoners who break or disable limbs; the foster sons shall return to their clans, and 500 strings of Zhongtong paper money shall still be collected as support funds.

sentences.zh: 諸尊長輒以微罪刺傷弟侄雙目者，與常人同罪，杖一百七，追征贍養鈔二十錠給苦主，免流，識過於門；

translations.literal: All elders who rashly for trivial offense stab and injure younger brothers' or nephews' both eyes receive the same crime as commoners, 107 blows with the rod, collect twenty ingots of support paper money for the aggrieved party, exempt from exile, mark the offense at the gate;
translations.idiomatic: All elders who rashly for a trivial offense stab and injure a younger brother's or nephew's both eyes shall receive the same penalty as commoners — 107 blows with the rod — collect twenty ingots of support paper money for the aggrieved party, be exempt from exile, and have the offense marked at the gate;

sentences.zh: 無罪者，仍流。

translations.literal: If the victim was innocent, still exile.
translations.idiomatic: if the victim was innocent, exile still applies.

sentences.zh: 諸弟雖聽其兄之仇，同謀剜其兄之眼，即以弟為首，各杖一百七，流遠，而弟加遠。

translations.literal: All younger brothers who though permitted to avenge their elder brother jointly gouge out their elder brother's eyes — treat the younger brother as principal; each receives 107 blows with the rod and exile to distant regions, and the younger brother is exiled farther.
translations.idiomatic: All younger brothers who though permitted to avenge their elder brother jointly gouge out their elder brother's eyes — the younger brother is treated as principal; each shall receive 107 blows with the rod and be exiled to distant regions, and the younger brother shall be exiled farther.

sentences.zh: 諸卑幼挾仇，輒刺傷尊長雙目成廢疾者，杖一百七，流遠。

translations.literal: All juniors who harbor enmity and rashly stab and injure elders' both eyes causing permanent disability receive 107 blows with the rod and exile to distant regions.
translations.idiomatic: All juniors who harbor enmity and rashly stab and injure an elder's both eyes causing permanent disability shall receive 107 blows with the rod and be exiled to distant regions.

sentences.zh: 諸以刃刺破人兩目成篤疾者，杖一百七，流遠，仍征中統鈔二十錠，充養贍之貲，主使者亦如之。

translations.literal: All who with a blade stab and break a person's both eyes causing grave disability receive 107 blows with the rod and exile to distant regions; still collect twenty ingots of Zhongtong paper money as support funds; instigators are treated the same.
translations.idiomatic: All who with a blade stab and break a person's both eyes causing grave disability shall receive 107 blows with the rod and be exiled to distant regions; twenty ingots of Zhongtong paper money shall still be collected as support funds; instigators are treated the same.

sentences.zh: 諸挾仇傷人之目者，若一目元損，又傷其一目，與傷兩目同論，雖會赦，仍流。

translations.literal: All who harbor enmity and injure a person's eyes: if one eye was originally damaged and they injure the other eye, it is judged the same as injuring both eyes; even if amnestied, still exile.
translations.idiomatic: All who harbor enmity and injure a person's eyes: if one eye was originally damaged and they injure the remaining eye, it is judged the same as injuring both eyes; even if an amnesty applies, exile still stands.

sentences.zh: 諸因爭誤瞎人一目者，杖七十七，征中統鈔五十兩，充醫藥之貲。

translations.literal: All who in dispute accidentally blind one eye receive 77 blows with the rod; collect fifty taels of Zhongtong paper money as medical funds.
translations.idiomatic: All who in a dispute accidentally blind one eye shall receive 77 blows with the rod; fifty taels of Zhongtong paper money shall be collected as medical funds.

sentences.zh: 諸脫脫禾孫輒毆傷往來使臣者，笞四十七，解職記過。

translations.literal: All Totoq who rashly assault and injure traveling envoys receive 47 lashes, are dismissed and have offense noted.
translations.idiomatic: All Totoq who rashly assault and injure traveling envoys shall receive 47 blows with the rod, be dismissed, and have the offense noted on their record.

sentences.zh: 諸職官輒以他物毆傷使臣者，杖六十七。

translations.literal: All officials who rashly with other objects assault and injure envoys receive 67 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All officials who rashly assault and injure envoys with other objects shall receive 67 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸司屬官輒毆本管上司幕官者，笞四十七，解職記過。

translations.literal: All subordinate officials who rashly beat their supervising superior's staff officers receive 47 lashes, are dismissed and have offense noted.
translations.idiomatic: All subordinate officials who rashly beat their supervising superior's staff officers shall receive 47 blows with the rod, be dismissed, and have the offense noted on their record.

sentences.zh: 諸方鎮僚屬輒以他物毆傷主帥者，杖六十七，幕官使酒罵長官者，笞四十七，並解職別敘，記過。

translations.literal: All regional command staff who rashly with other objects assault and injure the commander receive 67 blows; staff officers who through wine abuse and curse superiors receive 47 lashes; all are dismissed and reassigned elsewhere, notation of offense.
translations.idiomatic: All regional command staff who rashly assault and injure the commander with other objects shall receive 67 blows with the rod; staff officers who through drunkenness abuse and curse superiors shall receive 47 blows with the rod; all shall be dismissed, reassigned elsewhere, and have the offense noted on their record.

sentences.zh: 諸按部官因爭辯，輒毆有司官，有司官還毆者，各笞三十七，解職。

translations.literal: All touring inspection officials who in dispute rashly beat local officials, and local officials who retaliate, each receive 37 lashes and are dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: All touring inspection officials who in a dispute rashly beat local officials, and local officials who retaliate, shall each receive 37 blows with the rod and be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 諸監臨官挾怨，當廳扯捽屬官，屬官輒毆之者，笞四十七，解職。

translations.literal: All supervising officials who harbor resentment and in the hall grab and wrestle subordinate officials, and subordinate officials who rashly beat them, receive 47 lashes and are dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: All supervising officials who harbor resentment and in the hall grab and wrestle subordinate officials, and subordinate officials who rashly beat them, shall receive 47 blows with the rod and be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 諸方面大臣，不能以正率下，輒與幕屬公堂鬥爭，雖會赦，並罷免記過，赦前無招者還職。

translations.literal: All regional grand ministers who cannot lead subordinates uprightly and rashly fight with staff in the public hall, even if amnestied, are all dismissed with notation of offense; those without confession before amnesty are restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: All regional grand ministers who cannot lead subordinates uprightly and rashly fight with staff in the public hall shall, even if an amnesty applies, all be dismissed with the offense noted on their record; those who had not confessed before the amnesty shall be restored to office.

sentences.zh: 諸職官輒毆傷所監臨，以所毆傷法論罪，記過。

translations.literal: All officials who rashly assault and injure those they supervise are punished according to the assault injury law, notation of offense.
translations.idiomatic: All officials who rashly assault and injure those they supervise shall be punished according to the assault injury law and have the offense noted on their record.

sentences.zh: 諸職官毆傷同署長官者，笞五十七，解見任，降先品一等敘，仍記過名。

translations.literal: All officials who assault and injure the chief of the same office receive 57 lashes, are dismissed from current post, reinstated one grade below former rank, and still have offense noted by name.
translations.idiomatic: All officials who assault and injure the chief of the same office shall receive 57 blows with the rod, be dismissed from their current post, be reinstated one grade below their former rank, and still have the offense noted by name.

sentences.zh: 諸有司長官，輒毆同位正官者，笞三十七，毆佐貳官者，二十七，並解職記過。

translations.literal: All department heads who rashly beat co-equal regular officials receive 37 lashes; those who beat deputy officials receive 27 lashes; all are dismissed with notation of offense.
translations.idiomatic: All department heads who rashly beat co-equal regular officials shall receive 37 blows with the rod; those who beat deputy officials shall receive 27 blows with the rod; all shall be dismissed and have the offense noted on their record.

sentences.zh: 諸同僚改除，復以私忿相毆詈者，皆罷其所受新命。

translations.literal: All colleagues who after transfer appointments again assault and abuse each other from private resentment all forfeit their newly received appointments.
translations.idiomatic: All colleagues who after transfer appointments again assault and abuse each other from private resentment shall all forfeit their newly received appointments.

sentences.zh: 諸在閑職官，輒毆詈本籍在任長官者，杖六十七。

translations.literal: All idle officials who rashly assault and abuse the serving chief of their native place receive 67 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All idle officials who rashly assault and abuse the serving chief of their native place shall receive 67 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸職官相毆，其官等，從所傷輕重論罪。

translations.literal: All officials who mutually assault — as to official rank, punish according to the severity of injury.
translations.idiomatic: When officials mutually assault one another, as to official rank, punishment follows the severity of the injury.

sentences.zh: 諸軍官縱酒，因戲而怒，故毆傷有司官者，笞三十七，記過。

translations.literal: All military officers who through excessive wine in play become angry and deliberately assault and injure local officials receive 37 lashes, notation of offense.
translations.idiomatic: All military officers who through excessive wine in play become angry and deliberately assault and injure local officials shall receive 37 blows with the rod and have the offense noted on their record.

sentences.zh: 諸幕僚因公輒以惡言詈長官者，笞四十七，長官輒還毆者，笞一十七，並記過名。

translations.literal: All staff officers who on official business rashly curse superiors with foul language receive 47 lashes; superiors who rashly retaliate receive 17 lashes; all have offense noted by name.
translations.idiomatic: All staff officers who on official business rashly curse superiors with foul language shall receive 47 blows with the rod; superiors who rashly retaliate shall receive 17 blows with the rod; all shall have the offense noted by name.

sentences.zh: 諸職官乘醉當街毆傷平人者，笞四十七，記過。

translations.literal: All officials who while drunk assault and injure commoners in the street receive 47 lashes, notation of offense.
translations.idiomatic: All officials who while drunk assault and injure commoners in the street shall receive 47 blows with the rod and have the offense noted on their record.

sentences.zh: 諸職官閑居與庶民相毆者，職官減一等，聽罰贖。

translations.literal: All officials at leisure who mutually assault commoners — officials are reduced one grade and permitted commutation by fine.
translations.idiomatic: When officials at leisure mutually assault commoners, officials are punished one grade lighter and permitted commutation by fine.

sentences.zh: 諸以他物毆傷職官者，加一等，笞五十七。

translations.literal: All who with other objects assault and injure officials add one grade, 57 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: All who assault and injure officials with other objects shall receive one grade heavier — 57 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸小民恃年老毆詈所屬官長者，杖六十七，不聽贖。

translations.literal: All commoners who relying on old age assault and abuse their subordinate officials receive 67 blows with the rod; commutation is not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: All commoners who relying on old age assault and abuse their subordinate officials shall receive 67 blows with the rod; commutation is not permitted.

sentences.zh: 諸惡少無賴輒毆傷禁近之人者，杖七十七。

translations.literal: All wicked youths and ruffians who rashly assault and injure persons near the forbidden precinct receive 77 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All wicked youths and ruffians who rashly assault and injure persons near the forbidden precinct shall receive 77 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: ○殺傷

translations.literal: ○ Killing and Injury
translations.idiomatic: Killing and Injury

sentences.zh: 諸殺人者死，仍於家屬征燒埋銀五十兩給苦主，無銀者征中統鈔一十錠，會赦免罪者倍之。

translations.literal: All who kill a person are put to death; still collect from the household fifty taels of burial compensation silver for the aggrieved party; if no silver, collect ten ingots of Zhongtong paper money; if amnesty exempts the crime, double it.
translations.idiomatic: All who kill a person shall be put to death; burial compensation silver of fifty taels shall still be collected from the household for the aggrieved party; if there is no silver, ten ingots of Zhongtong paper money shall be collected; if an amnesty exempts the crime, the amount is doubled.

sentences.zh: 諸部民毆死官長，主謀及下手者皆處死，同毆傷非致命者，杖一百七，流遠，均征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All subordinates who beat a superior to death — ringleaders and those who struck are all put to death; those who jointly assaulted without fatal injury receive 107 blows with the rod, exile to distant regions, and equally collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All subordinates who beat a superior to death — ringleaders and those who struck shall all be put to death; those who jointly assaulted without causing fatal injury shall receive 107 blows with the rod, be exiled to distant regions, and equally pay burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸殺人還自殺不死者，仍處死。

translations.literal: All who after killing attempt suicide but do not die are still put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All who after killing attempt suicide but fail to die shall still be put to death.

sentences.zh: 諸殺人從而加功，無故殺之情者，會赦仍釋之。

translations.literal: All who in killing follow and add effort without intent to deliberately kill, if amnestied are still released.
translations.idiomatic: All who in killing follow and add effort without intent to deliberately kill shall, if an amnesty applies, still be released.

sentences.zh: 諸鬥毆殺人，先誤後故者，即以故殺論。

translations.literal: All who in affray kill a person, first accidental then deliberate, are judged as deliberate killing.
translations.idiomatic: All who in affray kill a person, first accidental then deliberate, shall be judged as deliberate killing.

sentences.zh: 諸因鬥毆，以刃殺人，及他物毆死人者，並同故殺。

translations.literal: All who in affray kill with a blade, or beat a person to death with other objects, are all treated the same as deliberate killing.
translations.idiomatic: All who in affray kill with a blade, or beat a person to death with other objects, shall all be treated the same as deliberate killing.

sentences.zh: 諸因爭以刃傷人，幸獲生免者，杖一百七。

translations.literal: All who in dispute injure a person with a blade and fortunately survive receive 107 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who in a dispute injure a person with a blade and the victim fortunately survives shall receive 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸持刃方殺人，人覺而逃，卻移怒殺所解勸者，與故殺同。

translations.literal: All who holding a blade are about to kill, the person notices and flees, but they shift anger and kill the one who intervened to restrain them — same as deliberate killing.
translations.idiomatic: All who holding a blade are about to kill, the person notices and flees, but they shift their anger and kill the one who intervened to restrain them — this is treated the same as deliberate killing.

sentences.zh: 諸有司征科急，民弗堪，致殺其征科者，仍以故殺論。

translations.literal: All where officials collect taxes urgently and the people cannot bear it, leading to killing the tax collector, are still judged as deliberate killing.
translations.idiomatic: All cases where officials collect taxes urgently and the people cannot bear it, leading to the killing of the tax collector, shall still be judged as deliberate killing.

sentences.zh: 諸醉中欲殺其妻不得，移怒殺死其解紛之人者，處死。

translations.literal: All who while drunk wish to kill their wives but fail, shift anger and kill the one who intervened to settle the dispute, are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All who while drunk wish to kill their wives but fail, shift their anger and kill the one who intervened to settle the dispute, shall be put to death.

sentences.zh: 諸欲誘倡女逃，不從輒殺之者，與殺常人同。

translations.literal: All who wish to entice a courtesan to flee and when she refuses rashly kill her are treated the same as killing a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: All who wish to entice a courtesan to flee and when she refuses rashly kill her shall be treated the same as killing a commoner.

sentences.zh: 諸鬥毆殺人者，結案待報。

translations.literal: All who kill in affray — close the case and await report.
translations.idiomatic: All who kill in affray — the case is closed and execution awaits imperial report.

sentences.zh: 諸人殺死其父，子毆之死者，不坐，仍於殺父者之家征燒埋銀五十兩。

translations.literal: All where a person kills another's father and the son beats him to death — the son is not punished; still collect fifty taels of burial compensation silver from the killer's household.
translations.idiomatic: If a person kills another's father and the son beats the killer to death, the son is not punished; fifty taels of burial compensation silver shall still be collected from the killer's household.

sentences.zh: 諸蒙古人因爭及乘醉毆死漢人者，斷罰出征，並全征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All Mongols who in dispute or while drunk beat Han Chinese to death are sentenced to military expedition and fully collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All Mongols who in a dispute or while drunk beat Han Chinese to death shall be sentenced to military expedition and shall fully pay burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸因閧爭，一人誤蹂死小兒，一人毆人致死，毆者結案，蹂者杖一百七，並征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All who in a brawl — one accidentally tramples a child to death, one beats a person to death — the beater's case is closed; the trampler receives 107 blows with the rod; both collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: In a brawl, if one person accidentally tramples a child to death and another beats a person to death, the beater's case is closed for execution; the trampler shall receive 107 blows with the rod; both shall pay burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸有人戲調其妻，夫遇而毆之，因傷而死者，減死一等論罪，仍征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All where someone playfully flirts with another's wife, the husband encounters and beats him, and he dies from injury — reduce death by one grade in judgment; still collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: If someone playfully flirts with another's wife, the husband encounters and beats him, and he dies from the injury, the crime is reduced one grade below death; burial compensation silver shall still be collected.

sentences.zh: 諸毆死應捕殺惡逆之人者，免罪，不征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All who beat to death a person who should be captured and killed for treason are exempt from punishment; burial compensation silver is not collected.
translations.idiomatic: All who beat to death a person who should be captured and killed for treason are exempt from punishment, and burial compensation silver is not collected.

sentences.zh: 諸以他物傷人，傷毒流註而死，雖在辜限之外，仍減殺人罪三等坐之。

translations.literal: All who with other objects injure a person, poison from the wound spreads and causes death — even outside the grace period limit, still reduce the homicide crime by three grades in punishment.
translations.idiomatic: All who with other objects injure a person, and poison from the wound spreads and causes death — even outside the grace period — shall still have the homicide crime reduced by three grades.

sentences.zh: 諸因爭，以頭觸人，與人俱仆，肘抵其心，邂逅致死者，杖一百七，全征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All who in dispute head-butt a person, both fall, elbow strikes the heart, and accidentally cause death receive 107 blows with the rod and fully collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All who in a dispute head-butt a person, both fall, an elbow strikes the heart, and death accidentally results shall receive 107 blows with the rod and shall fully pay burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸出使從人，毆死館夫者，以毆殺論。

translations.literal: All envoys' attendants who beat an innkeeper to death are judged as beating to death.
translations.idiomatic: All envoys' attendants who beat an innkeeper to death shall be judged under the law on beating to death.

sentences.zh: 諸因戲言相毆，致傷人命者，杖一百七。

translations.literal: All who through playful words mutually assault and cause injury to life receive 107 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who through playful words mutually assault and cause loss of life shall receive 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸父亡，母復納他人為夫，即為義父。

translations.literal: All where the father dies and the mother again takes another as husband, he becomes the stepfather.
translations.idiomatic: If the father dies and the mother again takes another as husband, he becomes the stepfather.

sentences.zh: 若逐其子出居於外，即同凡人，其有所鬥毆殺傷，即以凡人鬥毆殺傷論。

translations.literal: If the son is driven out to live elsewhere, he is treated the same as an ordinary person; any affray, killing, or injury is judged according to ordinary affray, killing, and injury.
translations.idiomatic: If the son is driven out to live elsewhere, he is treated the same as an ordinary person; any affray, killing, or injury shall be judged according to the laws on ordinary affray, killing, and injury.

sentences.zh: 諸彼此有罪之人，相格致死者，與殺常人同。

translations.literal: All mutually guilty persons who in mutual struggle cause death are treated the same as killing a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: All mutually guilty persons who in mutual struggle cause death shall be treated the same as killing a commoner.

sentences.zh: 諸職官以微故毆死齊民者，處死，諸職官受贓，為民所告，輒毆死告者，以故殺論。

translations.literal: All officials who for trivial cause beat commoners to death are put to death; all officials who take bribes and when reported by the people rashly beat the accuser to death are judged as deliberate killing.
translations.idiomatic: All officials who for a trivial cause beat commoners to death shall be put to death; all officials who take bribes and when reported by the people rashly beat the accuser to death shall be judged as deliberate killing.

sentences.zh: 諸軍官因公乘怒，輒命麾下毆人致死者，杖八十七，解職，期年後降先品一等敘，征燒埋銀給苦主，若會赦，仍殿降征銀。

translations.literal: All military officers who on official business in anger rashly order subordinates to beat a person to death receive 87 blows with the rod, are dismissed, after one year reinstated one grade below former rank, collect burial compensation silver for the aggrieved party; if amnestied, still demoted one grade and collect silver.
translations.idiomatic: All military officers who on official business in anger rashly order subordinates to beat a person to death shall receive 87 blows with the rod, be dismissed, after one year be reinstated one grade below their former rank, and pay burial compensation silver to the aggrieved party; if an amnesty applies, they shall still be demoted one grade and pay the silver.

sentences.zh: 諸閫帥侵盜系官錢糧，怒吏發其奸，輒令人毆死者，以故殺論，雖會大赦，仍追奪不敘，倍征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All commanders who embezzle government money and grain, and when clerks expose their fraud rashly have someone beaten to death are judged as deliberate killing; even if a great amnesty applies, still stripped and not reinstated, double burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All commanders who embezzle government money and grain, and when clerks expose their fraud rashly have someone beaten to death shall be judged as deliberate killing; even if a great amnesty applies, they shall still be stripped of office and not reinstated, and pay double burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸局院官輒以微故毆死匠人者，處死。

translations.literal: All bureau officials who rashly for trivial cause beat artisans to death are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All bureau officials who rashly for a trivial cause beat artisans to death shall be put to death.

sentences.zh: 諸父無故以刃殺其子者，杖七十七。

translations.literal: All fathers who without cause kill their sons with a blade receive 77 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All fathers who without cause kill their sons with a blade shall receive 77 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸子不孝，父與弟侄同謀置之死地者，父不坐，弟侄杖一百七。

translations.literal: All unfilial sons where the father and younger brothers and nephews jointly plot to put them to death — the father is not punished, younger brothers and nephews receive 107 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All unfilial sons where the father and younger brothers and nephews jointly plot to put them to death — the father is not punished; the younger brothers and nephews shall receive 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸女已嫁，聞女有過，輒殺其女者，笞五十七，追還元受聘財，給夫別娶。

translations.literal: All where a daughter is already married and upon hearing of her misconduct rashly kills her receive 57 lashes; originally received betrothal gifts are recovered and given to the husband for another marriage.
