translations.idiomatic: All who, upon hearing of misconduct by an already married daughter, rashly kill her shall receive 57 blows with the rod; originally received betrothal gifts shall be recovered and given to the husband for another marriage.

sentences.zh: 諸父有故毆其子女，邂逅致死者，免罪。

translations.literal: All where a father with cause beats his children and accidentally causes death is exempt from punishment.
translations.idiomatic: All cases where a father with cause beats his children and accidentally causes death are exempt from punishment.

sentences.zh: 諸後夫毆死前夫之子者，處死。

translations.literal: All stepfathers who beat a former husband's son to death are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All stepfathers who beat a former husband's son to death shall be put to death.

sentences.zh: 諸妻故殺妾子者，杖九十七，從其夫嫁賣。

translations.literal: All wives who deliberately kill a concubine's son receive 97 blows with the rod and follow the husband in being sold in remarriage.
translations.idiomatic: All wives who deliberately kill a concubine's son shall receive 97 blows with the rod and be sold in remarriage at the husband's direction.

sentences.zh: 諸男婦雖有過，舅姑輒加殘虐致死者，杖一百七。

translations.literal: All where a daughter-in-law though at fault is rashly cruelly abused to death by parents-in-law receive 107 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All cases where a daughter-in-law, though at fault, is rashly cruelly abused to death by parents-in-law shall receive 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸子不孝，父殺其子，因及其婦者，杖七十七，婦元有妝奩之物，盡歸其父母。

translations.literal: All unfilial sons where the father kills the son and thereby involves the wife receive 77 blows; the wife's original dowry items all return to her parents.
translations.idiomatic: All unfilial sons where the father kills the son and thereby involves the wife — the father shall receive 77 blows with the rod; the wife's original dowry items shall all return to her parents.

sentences.zh: 諸以細故殺其弟者，處死。

translations.literal: All who for trivial cause kill their younger brother are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All who for a trivial cause kill their younger brother shall be put to death.

sentences.zh: 諸兄以立繼之子，主謀殺其嫡弟者，主謀下手皆處死，其田宅人口財物盡歸死者妻子，其子歸宗。

translations.literal: All where an elder brother's established heir jointly plots to kill his full younger brother — ringleaders and those who struck are all put to death; fields, houses, persons, and property all go to the deceased's wife and children; the son returns to the clan.
translations.idiomatic: All cases where an elder brother's established heir jointly plots to kill his full younger brother — ringleaders and those who struck shall all be put to death; fields, houses, persons, and property shall all go to the deceased's wife and children; the son shall return to the clan.

sentences.zh: 諸弟先毆其兄，兄還殺其弟，即兄殺有罪之弟，不以凡人鬥殺論。

translations.literal: All where the younger brother first beats the elder brother and the elder brother in retaliation kills the younger brother — the elder brother kills a guilty younger brother and is not judged as ordinary affray killing.
translations.idiomatic: If the younger brother first beats the elder brother and the elder brother in retaliation kills the younger brother, the elder brother kills a guilty younger brother and is not judged under the law on ordinary affray killing.

sentences.zh: 諸因爭誤毆死異居弟者，杖七十七，征燒埋銀之半。

translations.literal: All who in dispute accidentally beat a separately residing younger brother to death receive 77 blows with the rod and collect half the burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All who in a dispute accidentally beat a separately residing younger brother to death shall receive 77 blows with the rod and pay half the burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸因爭故殺族弟者，與殺常人同。

translations.literal: All who in dispute deliberately kill a clan younger brother are treated the same as killing a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: All who in a dispute deliberately kill a clan younger brother shall be treated the same as killing a commoner.

sentences.zh: 諸妹為尼與人私，兄聞而諫之，不從，反詬詈扯捽其兄，兄殺之，即兄殺有罪之妹，不以凡人鬥殺論。

translations.literal: All where a sister who is a nun has illicit relations, the elder brother hears and admonishes her, she does not obey but instead curses and grabs the elder brother, and the elder brother kills her — the elder brother kills a guilty sister and is not judged as ordinary affray killing.
translations.idiomatic: If a sister who is a nun has illicit relations, the elder brother hears and admonishes her, she does not obey but instead curses and grabs the elder brother, and the elder brother kills her — the elder brother kills a guilty sister and is not judged under the law on ordinary affray killing.

sentences.zh: 諸兄毆弟妻，因傷而死者，杖一百七，征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All where an elder brother beats his younger brother's wife and she dies from injury receive 107 blows with the rod and collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: If an elder brother beats his younger brother's wife and she dies from the injury, he shall receive 107 blows with the rod and pay burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸嫂溺死其小姑者，以故殺論。

translations.literal: All where a sister-in-law drowns her husband's younger sister is judged as deliberate killing.
translations.idiomatic: All cases where a sister-in-law drowns her husband's younger sister shall be judged as deliberate killing.

sentences.zh: 諸因爭毆死族兄弟之子者，杖一百七；

translations.literal: All who in dispute beat a clan brother's son to death receive 107 blows with the rod;
translations.idiomatic: All who in a dispute beat a clan brother's son to death shall receive 107 blows with the rod;

sentences.zh: 故以刃殺之者，處死，並征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: if deliberately killing with a blade, put to death, and collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: if deliberately killing with a blade, they shall be put to death and pay burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸毆死兄弟之子而圖其財者，處死。

translations.literal: All who beat a brother's son to death to seize his property are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All who beat a brother's son to death to seize his property shall be put to death.

sentences.zh: 諸夫婦同謀，殺其兄弟之子者，皆處死。

translations.literal: All husbands and wives who jointly plot to kill their brother's son are all put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All husbands and wives who jointly plot to kill their brother's son shall all be put to death.

sentences.zh: 諸尊長誤毆卑幼致死者，杖七十七，異居者仍征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All elders who accidentally beat juniors to death receive 77 blows with the rod; if separately residing, still collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All elders who accidentally beat juniors to death shall receive 77 blows with the rod; if separately residing, burial compensation silver shall still be collected.

sentences.zh: 諸以微過輒殺其妻者，處死。

translations.literal: All who for trivial offense rashly kill their wives are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All who for a trivial offense rashly kill their wives shall be put to death.

sentences.zh: 諸因夫妻反目，輒藥死其妻者，與故殺常人同。

translations.literal: All who because of marital discord rashly poison their wives to death are treated the same as deliberately killing a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: All who because of marital discord rashly poison their wives to death shall be treated the same as deliberately killing a commoner.

sentences.zh: 諸妻悖慢其舅姑，其夫毆之致死者，杖七十七。

translations.literal: All where a wife is disrespectful to parents-in-law and the husband beats her to death receive 77 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All cases where a wife is disrespectful to her parents-in-law and the husband beats her to death — the husband shall receive 77 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸夫臥疾，妻不侍湯藥，又詬詈其舅姑，以傷其夫之心，夫毆之，邂逅致死者，不坐。

translations.literal: All where the husband is bedridden, the wife does not attend with medicine, and also curses the parents-in-law, hurting the husband's heart, and the husband beats her and accidentally causes death — not punished.
translations.idiomatic: If the husband is bedridden, the wife does not attend him with medicine, and also curses her parents-in-law, hurting the husband's heart, and the husband beats her and accidentally causes death, he is not punished.

sentences.zh: 諸夫惡妻而愛妾，輒求妻微罪而殺之者，處死。

translations.literal: All husbands who hate their wives and love concubines and rashly seek trivial offenses to kill their wives are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All husbands who hate their wives and love concubines and rashly seek trivial offenses to kill their wives shall be put to death.

sentences.zh: 諸風聞涉疑，故殺定婚妻者，與殺凡人同論。

translations.literal: All who on hearsay and suspicion deliberately kill a betrothed wife are judged the same as killing a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: All who on hearsay and suspicion deliberately kill a betrothed wife shall be judged the same as killing a commoner.

sentences.zh: 諸妻以殘酷毆死其妾者，杖一百七，去衣受刑。

translations.literal: All wives who cruelly beat their concubines to death receive 107 blows with the rod and are punished stripped of outer garments.
translations.idiomatic: All wives who cruelly beat their concubines to death shall receive 107 blows with the rod and be punished stripped of outer garments.

sentences.zh: 諸舅以無實之罪故殺其甥者，與殺常人同論。

translations.literal: All uncles who on baseless charges deliberately kill their nephews are judged the same as killing a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: All uncles who on baseless charges deliberately kill their nephews shall be judged the same as killing a commoner.

sentences.zh: 諸因爭挾仇毆死其婿者，與殺常人同。

translations.literal: All who in dispute harboring enmity beat their son-in-law to death are treated the same as killing a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: All who in a dispute harboring enmity beat their son-in-law to death shall be treated the same as killing a commoner.

sentences.zh: 諸奴毆詈其主，主毆傷奴致死者，免罪。

translations.literal: All where slaves assault and abuse their masters and the master beats the slave to death is exempt from punishment.
translations.idiomatic: If slaves assault and abuse their masters and the master beats the slave to death, the master is exempt from punishment.

sentences.zh: 諸故殺無罪奴婢，杖八十七，因醉殺之者，減一等。

translations.literal: All who deliberately kill innocent slaves or servants receive 87 blows with the rod; if killing while drunk, reduce by one grade.
translations.idiomatic: All who deliberately kill innocent slaves or servants shall receive 87 blows with the rod; if killing while drunk, the penalty is reduced by one grade.

sentences.zh: 諸毆死擬放良奴婢者，杖七十七。

translations.literal: All who beat to death slaves or servants intended for manumission receive 77 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who beat to death slaves or servants intended for manumission shall receive 77 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸謀殺已放良奴婢者，與故殺常人同。

translations.literal: All who plot to kill already manumitted slaves or servants are treated the same as deliberately killing a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: All who plot to kill already manumitted slaves or servants shall be treated the same as deliberately killing a commoner.

sentences.zh: 諸良人以鬥毆殺人奴，杖一百七，征燒埋銀五十兩。

translations.literal: All commoners who in affray kill another's slave receive 107 blows with the rod and collect fifty taels of burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All commoners who in affray kill another's slave shall receive 107 blows with the rod and pay fifty taels of burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸良人戲殺他人奴者，杖七十七，征燒埋銀五十兩。

translations.literal: All commoners who in play kill another's slave receive 77 blows with the rod and collect fifty taels of burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All commoners who in play kill another's slave shall receive 77 blows with the rod and pay fifty taels of burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸奴毆死其弟，弟亦為同主奴，主乞貸死者聽。

translations.literal: All where a slave beats his younger brother to death and the younger brother is also a slave of the same master — if the master requests leniency for the deceased, it is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: If a slave beats his younger brother to death and the younger brother is also a slave of the same master, if the master requests leniency for the deceased, leniency is permitted.

sentences.zh: 諸異主奴婢相犯死者，同常人；

translations.literal: All where slaves or servants of different masters mutually offend causing death are treated the same as commoners;
translations.idiomatic: If slaves or servants of different masters mutually offend causing death, they are treated the same as commoners;

sentences.zh: 同主相犯至重刑者，仍依例結案。

translations.literal: where slaves of the same master offend each other reaching heavy punishment, still close the case according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: if slaves of the same master offend each other reaching heavy punishment, the case is still closed according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 諸地主毆死佃客者，杖一百七，征燒埋銀五十兩。

translations.literal: All landlords who beat tenant clients to death receive 107 blows with the rod and collect fifty taels of burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All landlords who beat tenant clients to death shall receive 107 blows with the rod and pay fifty taels of burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸醉中誤認他人為仇人，故殺致命者，雖誤同故。

translations.literal: All who while drunk mistakenly identify another as an enemy and deliberately kill causing death — though mistaken, same as deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: All who while drunk mistakenly identify another as an enemy and deliberately kill causing death — though mistaken, are treated the same as deliberate killing.

sentences.zh: 諸奴受本主命，執仇殺人者，減死流遠。

translations.literal: All slaves who on their master's orders avenge and kill a person receive death reduced to exile to distant regions.
translations.idiomatic: All slaves who on their master's orders avenge and kill a person shall have the death penalty reduced to exile to distant regions.

sentences.zh: 諸挾仇殺人會赦，為首下手者不赦，為從不曾下手者免死，徒一年，諸以老病殺人者，不以老病免。

translations.literal: All who harbor enmity and kill meeting amnesty — ringleaders and those who struck are not amnestied; followers who did not strike are exempt from death and receive one year penal servitude; all who kill due to old age or illness are not exempt due to old age or illness.
translations.idiomatic: All who harbor enmity and kill: if an amnesty applies, ringleaders and those who struck are not amnestied; followers who did not strike are exempt from death and receive one year of penal servitude; all who kill due to old age or illness are not exempt on those grounds.

sentences.zh: 諸謀故殺人年七十以上，並枷禁歸勘結案。

translations.literal: All who plot or deliberately kill aged seventy or above are all shackled, imprisoned, sent back for investigation, and case closed.
translations.idiomatic: All who plot or deliberately kill persons aged seventy or above shall all be shackled, imprisoned, sent back for investigation, and have their cases closed.

sentences.zh: 諸兩家之子，昏暮奔還，中路相迎，撞仆於地，因傷致死者，不坐，仍征鈔五十兩給苦主。

translations.literal: All where sons of two families at dusk run back and meet on the road, collide and fall, and death results from injury — not punished; still collect fifty taels of paper money for the aggrieved party.
translations.idiomatic: If sons of two families at dusk run back and meet on the road, collide and fall, and death results from the injury, they are not punished; fifty taels of paper money shall still be collected for the aggrieved party.

sentences.zh: 諸十五以下小兒，過失殺人者，免罪，征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All children under fifteen who through negligence kill a person are exempt from punishment and collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All children under fifteen who through negligence kill a person are exempt from punishment and shall pay burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸十五以下小兒，因爭毀傷人致死者，聽贖，征燒埋銀給苦主。

translations.literal: All children under fifteen who in dispute destroy and injure a person causing death are permitted commutation and collect burial compensation silver for the aggrieved party.
translations.idiomatic: All children under fifteen who in a dispute destroy and injure a person causing death are permitted commutation and shall pay burial compensation silver to the aggrieved party.

sentences.zh: 諸瞽者毆人，因傷致死，杖一百七，征燒埋銀給苦主。

translations.literal: All blind persons who beat a person and cause death from injury receive 107 blows with the rod and collect burial compensation silver for the aggrieved party.
translations.idiomatic: All blind persons who beat a person and cause death from the injury shall receive 107 blows with the rod and pay burial compensation silver to the aggrieved party.

sentences.zh: 諸病風狂，毆傷人致死，免罪，征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All who in wind sickness madness beat and injure a person causing death are exempt from punishment and collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All who in wind-sickness madness beat and injure a person causing death are exempt from punishment and shall pay burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸庸醫以針藥殺人者，杖一百七，征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All quack doctors who with needles and medicine kill a person receive 107 blows with the rod and collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All quack doctors who with needles and medicine kill a person shall receive 107 blows with the rod and pay burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸飏磚石剝鄰之果，誤傷人致死者，杖八十七，征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All who throw bricks and stones to knock down a neighbor's fruit and accidentally injure a person causing death receive 87 blows with the rod and collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All who throw bricks and stones to knock down a neighbor's fruit and accidentally injure a person causing death shall receive 87 blows with the rod and pay burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸軍士習射，招箭者不謹，致被傷而死，射者不坐，仍征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All where soldiers practice archery and the arrow-retriever is careless causing injury and death — the archer is not punished; still collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: If soldiers practice archery and the arrow-retriever is careless causing injury and death, the archer is not punished; burial compensation silver shall still be collected.

sentences.zh: 諸過誤踏死小兒，杖七十七，征燒埋銀給苦主。

translations.literal: All who through negligence trample a child to death receive 77 blows with the rod and collect burial compensation silver for the aggrieved party.
translations.idiomatic: All who through negligence trample a child to death shall receive 77 blows with the rod and pay burial compensation silver to the aggrieved party.

sentences.zh: 諸昏夜馳馬，誤觸人死，杖七十七，征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All who at night gallop horses and accidentally strike a person to death receive 77 blows with the rod and collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All who at night gallop horses and accidentally strike a person to death shall receive 77 blows with the rod and pay burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸驅車走馬，致傷人命者，杖七十七，征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All who drive carts or gallop horses causing injury to life receive 77 blows with the rod and collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All who drive carts or gallop horses causing injury to life shall receive 77 blows with the rod and pay burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸昏夜行車，不知有人在地，誤致轢死者，笞三十七，征燒埋銀之半給苦主。

translations.literal: All who at night drive carts not knowing a person is on the ground and accidentally run over and kill receive 37 lashes and collect half the burial compensation silver for the aggrieved party.
translations.idiomatic: All who at night drive carts not knowing a person is on the ground and accidentally run over and kill shall receive 37 blows with the rod and pay half the burial compensation silver to the aggrieved party.

sentences.zh: 諸幼小自相作戲，誤傷致死者，不坐。

translations.literal: All young children who mutually play and accidentally injure causing death are not punished.
translations.idiomatic: All young children who mutually play and accidentally injure causing death are not punished.

sentences.zh: 諸戲傷人命，自願休和者聽。

translations.literal: All playful injury to life where the parties voluntarily wish to settle peacefully is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: All cases of playful injury to life where the parties voluntarily wish to settle peacefully are permitted to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸兩人作戲爭物，一人放手，一人失勢跌死，放者不坐。

translations.literal: All where two persons playfully struggle over an object, one releases and the other loses balance and falls to death — the one who released is not punished.
translations.idiomatic: If two persons playfully struggle over an object, one releases and the other loses balance and falls to death, the one who released is not punished.

sentences.zh: 諸以物戲驚小兒，成疾而死者，杖六十七，追征燒埋銀五十兩。

translations.literal: All who with objects playfully frighten a child causing illness and death receive 67 blows with the rod and collect fifty taels of burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All who with objects playfully frighten a child causing illness and death shall receive 67 blows with the rod and pay fifty taels of burial compensation silver.

sentences.zh: 諸以戲與人相逐，致人跌傷而死者，其罪徒，仍征燒埋銀給苦主。

translations.literal: All who in play chase another causing a fall, injury, and death — the crime is penal servitude; still collect burial compensation silver for the aggrieved party.
translations.idiomatic: All who in play chase another causing a fall, injury, and death shall be sentenced to penal servitude; burial compensation silver shall still be collected for the aggrieved party.

sentences.zh: 諸駱駝在牧，嚙人而死者，牧人笞一十七，以駱駝給苦主。

translations.literal: All where camels under pasture bite a person to death — the herdsman receives 17 lashes and the camel is given to the aggrieved party.
translations.idiomatic: If camels under pasture bite a person to death, the herdsman shall receive 17 blows with the rod and the camel shall be given to the aggrieved party.

sentences.zh: 諸驛馬在野，嚙人而死者，以其馬給苦主，馬主別買當役。

translations.literal: All where post relay horses in the wild bite a person to death — the horse is given to the aggrieved party and the horse owner separately purchases a replacement for service.
translations.idiomatic: If post relay horses in the wild bite a person to death, the horse shall be given to the aggrieved party and the horse owner shall separately purchase a replacement for service.

sentences.zh: 諸奴故殺其子女，以誣其主者，杖一百七。

translations.literal: All slaves who deliberately kill their children to falsely accuse their master receive 107 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All slaves who deliberately kill their children to falsely accuse their master shall receive 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸因爭，以妻前夫男女溺死，誣賴人者，以故殺論。

translations.literal: All who in dispute drown the wife's children by a former husband and falsely implicate others are judged as deliberate killing.
translations.idiomatic: All who in a dispute drown the wife's children by a former husband and falsely implicate others shall be judged as deliberate killing.

sentences.zh: 諸後夫置毒飲食，與前夫子女食而死者，與藥死常人同。

translations.literal: All stepfathers who place poison in food and give it to a former husband's children causing death are treated the same as poisoning a commoner to death.
translations.idiomatic: All stepfathers who place poison in food and give it to a former husband's children causing death shall be treated the same as poisoning a commoner to death.

sentences.zh: 諸故殺無罪子孫，以誣賴仇人者，以故殺常人論。

translations.literal: All who deliberately kill innocent descendants to falsely implicate an enemy are judged as deliberately killing a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: All who deliberately kill innocent descendants to falsely implicate an enemy shall be judged as deliberately killing a commoner.

sentences.zh: 諸殺人無苦主者，免征燒埋銀，犯人財產人口並付其妻子，仍為民當差。

translations.literal: All killings with no aggrieved party — burial compensation silver is not collected; the offender's property and persons are all given to his wife and children, who still serve corvée as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: All killings with no aggrieved party — burial compensation silver is not collected; the offender's property and persons are all given to his wife and children, who still serve corvée as commoners.

sentences.zh: 諸殺有罪之人，免征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All who kill a guilty person — burial compensation silver is not collected.
translations.idiomatic: All who kill a guilty person — burial compensation silver is not collected.

sentences.zh: 諸圖財謀故殺人多者，皆淩遲處死，驗各賊所殺人數，於家屬均征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All who for property plot deliberate killing of many are all executed by dismemberment; verify each robber's number of killings and equally collect burial compensation silver from households.
translations.idiomatic: All who for property plot deliberate killing of many shall all be executed by dismemberment; verify each robber's number of killings and equally collect burial compensation silver from their households.

sentences.zh: 諸同居相毆而死，及殺人罪未結正而死者，並不征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All co-residents who mutually beat to death, and those who die before the homicide case is concluded — burial compensation silver is not collected in all cases.
translations.idiomatic: All co-residents who mutually beat to death, and those who die before the homicide case is concluded — in all cases burial compensation silver is not collected.

sentences.zh: 諸殺人者，被殺之人或家住他所，官征燒埋銀移本籍，得其家屬給之。

translations.literal: All killers where the killed person's household is elsewhere — officials collect burial compensation silver and transfer to the native registration, obtaining the household to pay it.
translations.idiomatic: All killers where the killed person's household is elsewhere — officials shall collect burial compensation silver and transfer it to the native registration, obtaining payment from the household.

sentences.zh: 諸鬥毆殺人，應徵燒埋銀，而犯人貧窶，不能出備，並其餘親屬無應徵之人，官與支給。

translations.literal: All affray killings where burial compensation silver should be collected but the offender is poor and cannot pay, and no other relatives are liable — officials provide payment.
translations.idiomatic: All affray killings where burial compensation silver should be collected but the offender is poor and cannot pay, and no other relatives are liable — officials shall provide payment.

sentences.zh: 諸致傷人命，應徵燒埋銀者，止征銀價中統鈔一十錠。

translations.literal: All causing injury to life where burial compensation silver should be collected — only collect the silver value in ten ingots of Zhongtong paper money.
translations.idiomatic: All cases causing injury to life where burial compensation silver should be collected — only the silver value in ten ingots of Zhongtong paper money shall be collected.

sentences.zh: 諸因爭同毆死人，會赦應倍征燒埋銀者，為首致命征中統鈔一十錠，為從均征一十錠。

translations.literal: All who in dispute jointly beat a person to death, if amnesty requires doubled burial compensation silver — the principal who caused death collects ten ingots of Zhongtong paper money, followers equally collect ten ingots.
translations.idiomatic: All who in a dispute jointly beat a person to death, if an amnesty requires doubled burial compensation silver — the principal who caused death shall pay ten ingots of Zhongtong paper money, and followers shall equally pay ten ingots.

sentences.zh: 諸毆死人，雖不見屍，招證明白者，仍征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: All who beat a person to death though the corpse is not seen, if confession and evidence are clear, still collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: All who beat a person to death though the corpse is not seen, if confession and evidence are clear, burial compensation silver shall still be collected.

sentences.zh: 諸僧道殺人，燒埋銀於常住追征。

translations.literal: All monks and Daoists who kill — burial compensation silver is collected from the monastery's permanent endowment.
translations.idiomatic: All monks and Daoists who kill — burial compensation silver shall be collected from the monastery's permanent endowment.

sentences.zh: 諸庸作毆傷人命，征燒埋銀，不及庸作之家。

translations.literal: All hired laborers who assault causing injury to life — collect burial compensation silver, not extending to the hired laborer's household.
translations.idiomatic: All hired laborers who assault causing injury to life — burial compensation silver shall be collected, not extending to the hired laborer's household.

sentences.zh: 諸奴毆人致死，犯在主家，於本主征燒埋銀；

translations.literal: All slaves who beat a person to death committing the offense in the master's household — collect burial compensation silver from the master;
translations.idiomatic: All slaves who beat a person to death committing the offense in the master's household — burial compensation silver shall be collected from the master;

sentences.zh: 不犯在主家，燒埋銀無可征者，不征於其主。

translations.literal: if not committing the offense in the master's household and burial compensation silver cannot be collected, do not collect from the master.
translations.idiomatic: if the offense was not committed in the master's household and burial compensation silver cannot be collected, it shall not be collected from the master.

sentences.zh: ○禁令

translations.literal: ○ Prohibitions
translations.idiomatic: Prohibitions

sentences.zh: 諸度量權衡不同者，犯人笞五十七。

translations.literal: All with nonstandard measures, weights, and balances — offenders receive 57 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: All with nonstandard measures, weights, and balances — offenders shall receive 57 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 司縣正官，初犯罰俸一月，再犯笞二十七，三犯別議，仍記過名。

translations.literal: Prefectural and county regular officials: first offense fine one month's salary, second offense 27 lashes, third offense separate deliberation, still notation by name.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural and county regular officials: on a first offense, fine one month's salary; on a second offense, 27 blows with the rod; on a third offense, separate deliberation; still notation by name.

sentences.zh: 路府州縣達魯花赤長官提調失職，初犯罰俸二十日，再犯別議。

translations.literal: Circuit, prefecture, district, and county darughachi chiefs who fail in supervision: first offense fine twenty days' salary, second offense separate deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit, prefecture, district, and county darughachi chiefs who fail in supervision: on a first offense, fine twenty days' salary; on a second offense, separate deliberation.

sentences.zh: 諸奏目及官府公文，並用國字，其有襲用畏兀字者，禁之。

translations.literal: All memorials and government documents must use the national script; those who continue using Uyghur script are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All memorials and government documents must use the national script; those who continue using Uyghur script are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸但降詔旨條畫，民間輒刻小本賣於市者，禁之。

translations.literal: All who privately print small books of issued edicts and articles for sale in the market are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All who privately print small books of issued edicts and articles for sale in the market are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸內外應佩符職官，輒以符付其傔從佩服者，禁之。

translations.literal: All inner and outer officials who should wear tally seals and rashly give their tally to attendants to wear are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All inner and outer officials who should wear tally seals and rashly give their tally to attendants to wear are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸官員朝會，服其朝服，私致敬於人臣者罰。

translations.literal: All officials at court assembly wearing court dress who privately pay respects to other ministers are punished.
translations.idiomatic: All officials at court assembly wearing court dress who privately pay respects to other ministers shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 諸隨朝文武百官，朝賀不至者，罰中統鈔十貫，失儀者罰中統鈔八貫。

translations.literal: All civil and military officials attending court who fail to arrive for congratulation are fined ten strings of Zhongtong paper money; those who breach etiquette are fined eight strings.
translations.idiomatic: All civil and military officials attending court who fail to arrive for congratulation shall be fined ten strings of Zhongtong paper money; those who breach etiquette shall be fined eight strings.

sentences.zh: 諸宰相出入，輒敢沖犯者，罪之。

translations.literal: All who rashly dare to collide with grand chancellors entering or leaving are punished.
translations.idiomatic: All who rashly dare to collide with grand chancellors entering or leaving shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 諸章服，惟蒙古人及宿衛之士，不許服龍鳳文，余並不禁。

translations.literal: All official dress: only Mongols and imperial guard soldiers may not wear dragon and phoenix patterns; all others are not forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All official dress: only Mongols and imperial guard soldiers may not wear dragon and phoenix patterns; all others are not forbidden.

sentences.zh: 謂龍，五爪二角者。

translations.literal: Dragon means five claws and two horns.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon means five claws and two horns.

sentences.zh: 職官一品、二品許服渾金花，三品服金答子，四品、五品服雲袖帶襕，六品、七品服六花，八品、九品服四花，職事散官從一高。

translations.literal: Officials of ranks one and two may wear solid gold flowers; rank three wears gold dazi; ranks four and five wear cloud-sleeve belt robes; ranks six and seven wear six-flower patterns; ranks eight and nine wear four-flower patterns; functional and honorary ranks follow the higher.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of ranks one and two may wear solid gold flowers; rank three wears gold dazi; ranks four and five wear cloud-sleeve belt robes; ranks six and seven wear six-flower patterns; ranks eight and nine wear four-flower patterns; functional and honorary ranks follow the higher rank.

sentences.zh: 命婦一品至三品服渾金，四品、五品服金答子，六品以下惟服銷金並金紗答子。

translations.literal: Ennobled wives of ranks one to three wear solid gold; ranks four and five wear gold dazi; rank six and below wear only gilded and gold-thread dazi.
translations.idiomatic: Ennobled wives of ranks one to three wear solid gold; ranks four and five wear gold dazi; rank six and below wear only gilded and gold-thread dazi.

sentences.zh: 首飾，一品至三品許用金珠寶玉，四品、五品用金玉真珠，六品以下用金，惟耳環用珠玉。

translations.literal: Head ornaments: ranks one to three may use gold, pearls, jade, and gems; ranks four and five use gold, jade, and true pearls; rank six and below use gold, but earrings may use pearls and jade.
translations.idiomatic: Head ornaments: ranks one to three may use gold, pearls, jade, and gems; ranks four and five use gold, jade, and true pearls; rank six and below use gold, but earrings may use pearls and jade.

sentences.zh: 同籍者，不限親疏，期親雖別籍並出嫁同。

translations.literal: Those of the same registration, regardless of closeness of kinship; close kin though separately registered or married out are the same.
translations.idiomatic: Those of the same registration, regardless of closeness of kinship, are treated the same; close kin though separately registered or married out are included.

sentences.zh: 車輿並不得用龍鳳文，一品至三品許用間金妝飾、銀螭頭、繡帶、青幔，四品、五品用素獅頭、繡帶、青幔，六品至九品用素雲頭、素帶、青幔。

translations.literal: Carriages and litters may not use dragon and phoenix patterns; ranks one to three may use interspersed gold ornament, silver chihou heads, embroidered belts, and blue curtains; ranks four and five use plain lion heads, embroidered belts, and blue curtains; ranks six to nine use plain cloud heads, plain belts, and blue curtains.
translations.idiomatic: Carriages and litters may not use dragon and phoenix patterns; ranks one to three may use interspersed gold ornament, silver chihou heads, embroidered belts, and blue curtains; ranks four and five use plain lion heads, embroidered belts, and blue curtains; ranks six to nine use plain cloud heads, plain belts, and blue curtains.

sentences.zh: 內外有出身考滿應入流見役人員，服用與九品同。

translations.literal: Inner and outer persons with official origin who completed examination and should enter the stream while currently serving wear the same as rank nine.
translations.idiomatic: Inner and outer persons with official origin who completed examination and should enter the stream while currently serving shall wear the same as rank nine.

sentences.zh: 受各投下令旨鈞旨，有印信見任人員，亦與九品同。

translations.literal: Persons receiving orders and commands with seals from various appanages while currently serving are also treated the same as rank nine.
translations.idiomatic: Persons receiving orders and commands with seals from various appanages while currently serving are also treated the same as rank nine.

sentences.zh: 庶人惟許服暗花纻絲、絲綢綾羅、毛毳，不許用赭黃，冒笠不得飾以金玉，靴不得裁置花樣。

translations.literal: Commoners may wear only dark-patterned hemp silk, silk, satin, and wool; ochre yellow is forbidden; hats may not be ornamented with gold or jade; boots may not be cut with decorative patterns.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners may wear only dark-patterned hemp silk, silk, satin, and wool; ochre yellow is forbidden; hats may not be ornamented with gold or jade; boots may not be cut with decorative patterns.

sentences.zh: 首飾許用翠花金釵篦各一事，惟耳環許用金珠碧甸，余並用銀。

translations.literal: Head ornaments may use one jadeite flower, gold hairpin, and comb each; only earrings may use gold, pearls, and green jade; all else uses silver.
translations.idiomatic: Head ornaments may use one jadeite flower, gold hairpin, and comb each; only earrings may use gold, pearls, and green jade; all else uses silver.

sentences.zh: 車輿，黑油齊頭平頂皂幔。

translations.literal: Carriages and litters: black lacquer, flat-topped, black curtains.
translations.idiomatic: Carriages and litters: black lacquer, flat-topped, black curtains.

sentences.zh: 諸色目人，除行營帳外，余並與庶人同。

translations.literal: Persons of various categories except those in campaign encampments are all treated the same as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Persons of various categories except those in campaign encampments are all treated the same as commoners.

sentences.zh: 職官致仕與見任同，解降者依應得品級；

translations.literal: Retired officials are treated the same as currently serving; those dismissed and demoted follow their entitled rank;
translations.idiomatic: Retired officials are treated the same as currently serving; those dismissed and demoted follow their entitled rank;

sentences.zh: 不敘者與庶人同。

translations.literal: those not reinstated are treated the same as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: those not reinstated are treated the same as commoners.

sentences.zh: 父祖有官，既歿年深，非犯除名不敘，其命婦及子孫與見任同。

translations.literal: If father or grandfather held office and long deceased, unless the offense was struck from rolls without reinstatement, ennobled wives and descendants are treated the same as currently serving.
translations.idiomatic: If a father or grandfather held office and has long been deceased, unless the offense was struck from the rolls without reinstatement, ennobled wives and descendants are treated the same as currently serving.

sentences.zh: 諸樂人工藝人等服用，與庶人同，凡承應妝扮之物，不拘上例。

translations.literal: All musicians, artisans, and similar persons wear the same as commoners; all costume items for performance are not bound by the above rules.
translations.idiomatic: All musicians, artisans, and similar persons wear the same as commoners; all costume items for performance are not bound by the above rules.

sentences.zh: 皂隸公使人，惟許服綢絹。

translations.literal: Runners and public messengers may wear only silk.
translations.idiomatic: Runners and public messengers may wear only silk.

sentences.zh: 倡家出入，止服皂褙，不許乘坐車馬。

translations.literal: Courtesan establishments going out may wear only black jackets and may not ride in carriages or on horses.
translations.idiomatic: Courtesan establishments going out may wear only black jackets and may not ride in carriages or on horses.

sentences.zh: 應服色等第，上得兼下，下不得僭上，違者，職官解見任，期年後降一等敘，余人笞五十七，違禁之物，付告捉人充賞。

translations.literal: For permitted dress grades, higher may include lower; lower may not usurp higher; violators — officials dismissed from current post, after one year reinstated one grade lower; others receive 57 lashes; prohibited items go to the accuser as reward.
translations.idiomatic: For permitted dress grades, higher may include lower; lower may not usurp higher; violators — officials shall be dismissed from their current post and after one year reinstated one grade lower; others shall receive 57 blows with the rod; prohibited items shall go to the accuser as reward.

sentences.zh: 禦賜之物，不在禁限。

translations.literal: Imperially bestowed items are not within the prohibition limits.
translations.idiomatic: Imperially bestowed items are not within the prohibition limits.

sentences.zh: 諸官員以黃金飾甲者禁之，違者甲匠同罪。

translations.literal: All officials who ornament armor with gold are forbidden; violators and armor makers are punished the same.
translations.idiomatic: All officials who ornament armor with gold are forbidden to do so; violators and armor makers shall be punished the same.

sentences.zh: 諸常人鞍韂，畫虎兔者聽，畫雲龍犀牛者，禁之。

translations.literal: All commoners' saddles and stirrups may depict tigers and rabbits; depicting clouds, dragons, rhinoceroses, and oxen is forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All commoners' saddles and stirrups may depict tigers and rabbits; depicting clouds, dragons, rhinoceroses, and oxen is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸段匹織造周身大龍者，禁之，胸背小龍者勿禁。

translations.literal: All bolt cloth woven with large dragons encircling the body is forbidden; small dragons on chest and back are not forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All bolt cloth woven with large dragons encircling the body is forbidden; small dragons on chest and back are not forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸市造鞍轡箭鏃靴履及諸雜帶，用金為飾者，禁之。

translations.literal: All saddles, bridles, arrowheads, boots, shoes, and miscellaneous belts manufactured in markets using gold as ornament are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All saddles, bridles, arrowheads, boots, shoes, and miscellaneous belts manufactured in markets using gold as ornament are forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸郡縣達魯花赤及諸投下，擅造軍器者，禁之。

translations.literal: All prefectural and county darughachi and various appanages who without authorization manufacture weapons are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All prefectural and county darughachi and various appanages who without authorization manufacture weapons are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸神廟儀仗，止以土木紙彩代之，用真兵器者禁。

translations.literal: All temple ritual implements must use wood, earth, paper, and colors as substitutes; using real weapons is forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All temple ritual implements must use wood, earth, paper, and colors as substitutes; using real weapons is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸都城小民，造彈弓及執者，杖七十七，沒其家財之半，在外郡縣不在禁限。

translations.literal: All commoners in the capital who manufacture or possess crossbows receive 77 blows with the rod and half their household property is confiscated; outer prefectures and counties are not within the prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: All commoners in the capital who manufacture or possess crossbows shall receive 77 blows with the rod and half their household property shall be confiscated; outer prefectures and counties are not within the prohibition.

sentences.zh: 諸打捕及捕盜巡馬弓手、巡鹽弓手，許執弓箭，余悉禁之。

translations.literal: All hunters, robber-catchers, patrol horse archers, and salt patrol archers may carry bows and arrows; all others are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All hunters, robber-catchers, patrol horse archers, and salt patrol archers may carry bows and arrows; all others are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸漢人持兵器者，禁之；

translations.literal: All Han Chinese who possess weapons are forbidden;
translations.idiomatic: All Han Chinese who possess weapons are forbidden to do so;

sentences.zh: 漢人為軍者不禁。

translations.literal: Han Chinese who serve as soldiers are not forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Han Chinese who serve as soldiers are not forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸賣軍器者，賣與應執把之人者不禁。

translations.literal: All who sell weapons — selling to persons permitted to carry them is not forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All who sell weapons — selling to persons permitted to carry them is not forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸民間有藏鐵尺、鐵骨朵，及含刀鐵拄杖者，禁之。

translations.literal: All who privately hoard iron rulers, iron maces, or walking sticks with concealed blades are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All who privately hoard iron rulers, iron maces, or walking sticks with concealed blades are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸私藏甲全副者，處死；

translations.literal: All who privately hoard a full suit of armor are put to death;
translations.idiomatic: All who privately hoard a full suit of armor shall be put to death;

sentences.zh: 不成副者，笞五十七，徒一年；

translations.literal: if not a complete set, 57 lashes and one year penal servitude;
translations.idiomatic: if not a complete set, 57 blows with the rod and one year of penal servitude;

sentences.zh: 零散甲片下堪穿系禦敵者，笞三十七。

translations.literal: scattered armor plates unsuitable for stringing to resist enemies receive 37 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: scattered armor plates unsuitable for stringing to resist enemies shall receive 37 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 槍若刀若弩私有十件者，處死；

translations.literal: If privately hoarding ten spears, knives, or crossbows, put to death;
translations.idiomatic: If privately hoarding ten spears, knives, or crossbows, they shall be put to death;

sentences.zh: 五件以上，杖九十七，徒三年；

translations.literal: five or more, 97 blows with the rod and three years penal servitude;
translations.idiomatic: five or more, 97 blows with the rod and three years of penal servitude;

sentences.zh: 四件以上，七十七，徒二年；

translations.literal: four or more, 77 blows and two years penal servitude;
translations.idiomatic: four or more, 77 blows with the rod and two years of penal servitude;

sentences.zh: 不堪使用，笞五十七。

translations.literal: if unusable, 57 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: if unusable, 57 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 弓箭私有十副者，處死；

translations.literal: If privately hoarding ten sets of bow and arrow, put to death;
translations.idiomatic: If privately hoarding ten sets of bow and arrow, they shall be put to death;

sentences.zh: 五副以上，杖九十七，徒三年；

translations.literal: five sets or more, 97 blows and three years penal servitude;
translations.idiomatic: five sets or more, 97 blows with the rod and three years of penal servitude;

sentences.zh: 四副以下，七十七，徒二年；

translations.literal: four sets or fewer, 77 blows and two years penal servitude;
translations.idiomatic: four sets or fewer, 77 blows with the rod and two years of penal servitude;

sentences.zh: 不成副，笞五十七。

translations.literal: if not a complete set, 57 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: if not a complete set, 57 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 凡弓一，箭三十，為一副。

translations.literal: One bow and thirty arrows constitute one set.
translations.idiomatic: One bow and thirty arrows constitute one set.

sentences.zh: 諸嶽瀆祠廟，輒敢觸犯作踐者，禁之。

translations.literal: All who rashly dare to trespass upon or trample sacred mountains, rivers, and temples are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All who rashly dare to trespass upon or trample sacred mountains, rivers, and temples are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸伏羲、媧皇、堯、舜、禹、湯、后土等廟，軍馬使臣敢沮壞者，禁之。

translations.literal: All temples of Fuxi, Nüwa, Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Hou Tu, and the like — military horses and envoys who dare to obstruct or damage them are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All temples of Fuxi, Nüwa, Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Hou Tu, and the like — military horses and envoys who dare to obstruct or damage them are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸名山大川寺觀祠廟，並前代名人遺跡，敢拆毀者，禁之。

translations.literal: All famous mountains, great rivers, temples, shrines, and traces of famous persons of former ages — those who dare to demolish them are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All famous mountains, great rivers, temples, shrines, and traces of famous persons of former ages — those who dare to demolish them are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸改寺為觀，改觀為寺者，禁之。

translations.literal: All who convert Buddhist temples to Daoist temples or Daoist temples to Buddhist temples are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All who convert Buddhist temples to Daoist temples or Daoist temples to Buddhist temples are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸祠廟寺觀，模勒御寶聖旨及諸王令旨者，禁之。

translations.literal: All temples, shrines, and monasteries who engrave imperial seals, edicts, and princely commands are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All temples, shrines, and monasteries who engrave imperial seals, edicts, and princely commands are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸為子行孝，輒以割肝、刲股、埋兒之屬為孝者，並禁止之。

translations.literal: All who as filial sons cut their livers, slice their thighs, or bury children and the like as filial piety are all forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All who as filial sons cut their livers, slice their thighs, or bury children and the like as filial piety are all forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸民間喪葬，以紙為屋室，金銀為馬，雜彩衣服帷帳者，悉禁之。

translations.literal: All folk funerals using paper for houses, gold and silver for horses, and multicolored clothes, curtains, and canopies are all forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All folk funerals using paper for houses, gold and silver for horses, and multicolored clothes, curtains, and canopies are all forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸墳墓以磚瓦為屋其上者，禁之。

translations.literal: All graves with brick and tile houses built atop them are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All graves with brick and tile houses built atop them are forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸家廟春秋祭祀，輒用公服行禮者，禁之。

translations.literal: All family temples using official dress in spring and autumn sacrifices are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All family temples using official dress in spring and autumn sacrifices are forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸民間祖宗神主，稱皇字者，禁之。

translations.literal: All folk ancestral spirit tablets using the character for emperor are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All folk ancestral spirit tablets using the character for emperor are forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸小民房屋，安置鵝項銜脊，有鱗爪瓦獸者，笞三十七，陶人二十七。

translations.literal: All commoners' houses with goose-neck ridge ornaments and scaled-claw tile beasts receive 37 lashes for the owner and 27 for the potter.
translations.idiomatic: All commoners' houses with goose-neck ridge ornaments and scaled-claw tile beasts shall receive 37 blows with the rod for the owner and 27 for the potter.

sentences.zh: 諸職官居見任，雖有善政，不許立碑，已立而犯贓汙者毀之，無治狀以虛譽立碑者毀之。

translations.literal: All officials while in current office, though they have good governance, may not erect steles; steles already erected by corrupt officials are destroyed; those erected on false reputation without governance record are destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: All officials while in current office, though they have good governance, may not erect steles; steles already erected by corrupt officials shall be destroyed; those erected on false reputation without a governance record shall be destroyed.

sentences.zh: 諸夜禁，一更三點，鐘聲絕，禁人行。

translations.literal: All night curfew: at the first watch third stroke when the bell stops, movement of persons is forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All night curfew: at the first watch third stroke when the bell stops, movement of persons is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 五更三點，鐘聲動，聽人行。

translations.literal: At the fifth watch third stroke when the bell sounds, movement of persons is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: At the fifth watch third stroke when the bell sounds, movement of persons is permitted.

sentences.zh: 違者笞二十七，有官者聽贖。

translations.literal: Violators receive 27 lashes; officials are permitted commutation.
translations.idiomatic: Violators shall receive 27 blows with the rod; officials are permitted commutation.

sentences.zh: 其公務急速，及疾病死喪產育之類不禁。

translations.literal: Urgent official business, illness, death, mourning, childbirth, and the like are not forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Urgent official business, illness, death, mourning, childbirth, and the like are not forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸有司曉鐘未動，寺觀輒鳴鐘者，禁之。

translations.literal: All where officials' dawn bell has not yet sounded and temples and monasteries rashly ring bells are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All cases where officials' dawn bell has not yet sounded and temples and monasteries rashly ring bells are forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸江南之地，每夜禁鐘以前，市井點燈買賣，曉鐘之後，人家點燈讀書工作者，並不禁。

translations.literal: All in Jiangnan regions before the night curfew bell, market lamps for buying and selling, and after the dawn bell household lamps for reading and working are not forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All in Jiangnan regions before the night curfew bell, market lamps for buying and selling, and after the dawn bell household lamps for reading and working are not forbidden.

sentences.zh: 其集眾祠禱者，禁之。

translations.literal: Mass gatherings for prayer are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Mass gatherings for prayer are forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸犯夜拒捕，斫傷僥巡者，杖一百七。

translations.literal: All who violate the night curfew and resist capture, hacking and injuring patrol officers receive 107 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who violate the night curfew and resist capture, hacking and injuring patrol officers shall receive 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸城郭人民，鄰甲相保，門置水徹，積水常盈，家設火具，每物須備，大風時作，則傳呼以徇於路。

translations.literal: All city dwellers: neighboring wards mutually guarantee, gates set with water dippers, water always full, households equipped with fire tools, each item must be ready; when strong winds arise, proclamation is made along the roads.
translations.idiomatic: All city dwellers: neighboring wards shall mutually guarantee one another, gates shall be set with water dippers with water always full, households shall be equipped with fire tools with each item ready; when strong winds arise, proclamation shall be made along the roads.

sentences.zh: 有司不時點視，凡救火之具不備者，罪之。

translations.literal: Officials inspect from time to time; all whose fire-fighting equipment is not complete are punished.
translations.idiomatic: Officials shall inspect from time to time; all whose fire-fighting equipment is not complete shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 諸遺火延燒系官房舍，杖七十七；

translations.literal: All negligent fires spreading to burn government buildings receive 77 blows with the rod;
translations.idiomatic: All negligent fires spreading to burn government buildings shall receive 77 blows with the rod;

sentences.zh: 延燒民房舍，笞五十七；

translations.literal: spreading to burn private houses receive 57 lashes;
translations.idiomatic: spreading to burn private houses shall receive 57 blows with the rod;

sentences.zh: 因致傷人命者，杖八十七；

translations.literal: if causing injury to life receive 87 blows with the rod;
translations.idiomatic: if causing injury to life, 87 blows with the rod;

sentences.zh: 所毀房舍財畜，公私俱免征償。

translations.literal: destroyed houses, property, and livestock — public and private are all exempt from compensation.
translations.idiomatic: destroyed houses, property, and livestock — public and private are all exempt from compensation.

sentences.zh: 燒自己房舍者，笞二十七，止坐失火之人。

translations.literal: Burning one's own house receives 27 lashes; only the person who caused the fire is punished.
translations.idiomatic: Burning one's own house shall receive 27 blows with the rod; only the person who caused the fire is punished.

sentences.zh: 諸煎鹽草地，輒縱野火延燒者，杖八十七，因致闕用者，奏取聖裁。

translations.literal: All who on salt-boiling grasslands rashly set wildfires causing spread receive 87 blows; if causing shortage of supply, memorialize for imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: All who on salt-boiling grasslands rashly set wildfires causing spread shall receive 87 blows with the rod; if causing shortage of supply, a memorial shall be submitted for imperial decision.

sentences.zh: 鄰接管民官，專一關防禁治。

translations.literal: Neighboring supervising civilian officials are solely responsible for guarding and prohibiting.
translations.idiomatic: Neighboring supervising civilian officials are solely responsible for guarding and prohibiting.

sentences.zh: 諸縱火圍獵，延燒民房舍錢谷者，斷罪勒償，償未盡而會赦者，免征。

translations.literal: All who set fires for hunting encirclement spreading to burn private houses and money and grain are sentenced and compelled to compensate; if compensation is incomplete and amnesty applies, collection is exempted.
translations.idiomatic: All who set fires for hunting encirclement spreading to burn private houses and money and grain shall be sentenced and compelled to compensate; if compensation is incomplete and an amnesty applies, collection is exempted.

sentences.zh: 諸故燒太子諸王房舍者，處死。

translations.literal: All who deliberately burn crown prince or princely residences are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All who deliberately burn crown prince or princely residences shall be put to death.

sentences.zh: 諸故燒官府廨宇，及有人居止宅舍，無問舍宇大小，財物多寡，比同強盜，免刺，杖一百七，徒三年；

translations.literal: All who deliberately burn government offices and dwellings, and any inhabited houses regardless of size or amount of property, are treated the same as robbery without tattoo, 107 blows with the rod and three years penal servitude;
translations.idiomatic: All who deliberately burn government offices and dwellings, and any inhabited houses regardless of size or amount of property, shall be treated the same as robbery without tattoo — 107 blows with the rod and three years of penal servitude;

sentences.zh: 因傷人命，同殺人。

translations.literal: if causing injury to life, same as homicide.
translations.idiomatic: if causing injury to life, the same as homicide.

sentences.zh: 其無人居止空房，並損壞財物，及田場積聚之物，同竊盜，免刺，計贓斷罪。

translations.literal: Uninhabited empty houses, damaged property, and field and storehouse accumulations are treated the same as theft without tattoo, calculating stolen value for sentencing.
translations.idiomatic: Uninhabited empty houses, damaged property, and field and storehouse accumulations shall be treated the same as theft without tattoo, calculating stolen value for sentencing.

sentences.zh: 因盜取財物者，同強盜，刺斷，並追陪所燒物價；

translations.literal: If stealing property while burning, same as robbery with tattoo and execution, and additionally compensate for burned goods' value;
translations.idiomatic: If stealing property while burning, the same as robbery with tattoo and execution, and additionally compensate for the burned goods' value;

sentences.zh: 傷人命者，仍征燒埋銀。

translations.literal: if injuring life, still collect burial compensation silver.
translations.idiomatic: if injuring life, burial compensation silver shall still be collected.

sentences.zh: 再犯者決配，役滿，徙千里之外。

translations.literal: On second offense, sentenced to corvée; after service completed, exiled a thousand li beyond.
translations.idiomatic: On a second offense, sentenced to corvée; after service is completed, exiled a thousand li beyond.

sentences.zh: 諸挾仇放火，隨時撲滅，不曾延燎者，比強盜不曾傷人不得財，杖七十七，徒一年半，免刺，雖親屬相犯，比同常人。

translations.literal: All who harbor enmity and set fires promptly extinguished without spreading are treated the same as robbery without injuring persons or obtaining property — 77 blows with the rod, one and a half years penal servitude, exempt from tattoo; even if relatives offend, treated the same as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: All who harbor enmity and set fires promptly extinguished without spreading shall be treated the same as robbery without injuring persons or obtaining property — 77 blows with the rod, one and a half years of penal servitude, exempt from tattoo; even if relatives offend, they are treated the same as commoners.

sentences.zh: 諸每月朔望二弦，凡有生之物，殺者禁之。

translations.literal: All on the first and fifteenth of the month and the two quarter moons, killing of living creatures is forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All on the first and fifteenth of the month and the two quarter moons, killing of living creatures is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸郡縣歲正月五月，各禁宰殺十日，其饑饉去處，自朔日為始，禁殺三日。

translations.literal: All prefectures and counties in the first and fifth months each forbid slaughter for ten days; in famine areas, from the first of the month, slaughter is forbidden for three days.
translations.idiomatic: All prefectures and counties in the first and fifth months each forbid slaughter for ten days; in famine areas, from the first of the month, slaughter is forbidden for three days.

sentences.zh: 諸每歲，自十二月至來歲正月，殺母羊者，禁之。

translations.literal: All each year from the twelfth month to the first month of the following year, killing ewes is forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All each year from the twelfth month to the first month of the following year, killing ewes is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸宴會，雖達官，殺馬為禮者，禁之。

translations.literal: All banquets, even for high officials, killing horses as courtesy is forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All banquets, even for high officials, killing horses as courtesy is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 其有老病不任鞍勒者，亦必與眾驗而後殺之。

translations.literal: If old or sick and unable to bear saddle and bridle, they must still be jointly verified by the multitude before killing.
translations.idiomatic: If old or sick and unable to bear saddle and bridle, they must still be jointly verified by the multitude before killing.

sentences.zh: 諸私宰牛馬者，杖一百，征鈔二十五兩，付告人充賞。

translations.literal: All who privately slaughter cattle or horses receive 100 blows with the rod; collect twenty-five taels of paper money paid to the accuser as reward.
translations.idiomatic: All who privately slaughter cattle or horses shall receive 100 blows with the rod; twenty-five taels of paper money shall be collected and paid to the accuser as reward.

sentences.zh: 兩鄰知而不首者，笞二十七。

translations.literal: Neighbors on both sides who know but do not report receive 27 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: Neighbors on both sides who know but fail to report shall receive 27 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 本管頭目失覺察者，笞五十七。

translations.literal: Local headmen who fail to detect receive 57 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: Local headmen who fail to detect shall receive 57 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 有見殺不告，因脅取錢物者，杖七十七。

translations.literal: Those who witness slaughter but do not report and thereby extort money receive 77 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: Those who witness slaughter but do not report and thereby extort money shall receive 77 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 若老病不任用者，從有司辨驗，方許宰殺。

translations.literal: If old or sick and unable to serve, after verification by officials, slaughter is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: If old or sick and unable to serve, after verification by officials, slaughter is permitted.

sentences.zh: 已病死者，申驗開剝，其筋角即付官，皮肉若不自用，須投稅貨賣，違者同匿稅法。

translations.literal: If already dead from illness, report and verify for flaying; sinews and horns go to the state; if flesh is not for personal use, must pay tax and sell; violators treated the same as concealing tax.
translations.idiomatic: If already dead from illness, report and verify for flaying; sinews and horns go to the state; if flesh is not for personal use, tax must be paid and it must be sold; violators are treated the same as concealing tax.

sentences.zh: 有司禁治不嚴者，糾之。

translations.literal: Officials whose prohibition enforcement is not strict are investigated.
translations.idiomatic: Officials whose prohibition enforcement is not strict shall be investigated.

sentences.zh: 諸私宰官馬牛，為首杖一百七，為從八十七。

translations.literal: All who privately slaughter government horses or cattle — principal receives 107 blows, followers 87.
translations.idiomatic: All who privately slaughter government horses or cattle — the principal shall receive 107 blows with the rod, followers 87 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸助力私宰馬牛者，減正犯人二等論罪。

translations.literal: All who assist in privately slaughtering horses or cattle are punished two grades lighter than the principal offender.
translations.idiomatic: All who assist in privately slaughtering horses or cattle shall be punished two grades lighter than the principal offender.

sentences.zh: 諸牛馬驢騾死，而筋角不盡實輸官者，一副以上，笞二十七；

translations.literal: All where cattle, horses, donkeys, or mules die and sinews and horns are not fully delivered to the state — one set or more, 27 lashes;
translations.idiomatic: All cases where cattle, horses, donkeys, or mules die and sinews and horns are not fully delivered to the state — one set or more, 27 blows with the rod;

sentences.zh: 五副以上，四十七；

translations.literal: five sets or more, 47 lashes;
translations.idiomatic: five sets or more, 47 blows with the rod;

sentences.zh: 十副以上，杖六十七，仍征所犯物價，付告人充賞。

translations.literal: ten sets or more, 67 blows with the rod, still collect the value of goods violated paid to the accuser as reward.
translations.idiomatic: ten sets or more, 67 blows with the rod, and the value of the goods violated shall still be collected and paid to the accuser as reward.

sentences.zh: 諸毀傷體膚以行丐於市者，禁之。

translations.literal: All who mutilate their flesh to beg in the market are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All who mutilate their flesh to beg in the market are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸城郭內外放鴿帶鈴者，禁之。

translations.literal: All who within or outside the walls release pigeons with bells are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All who within or outside the walls release pigeons with bells are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸諸王駙馬及諸權貴豪右，侵占山場，阻民樵采者，罪之。

translations.literal: All princes, imperial sons-in-law, and powerful nobles who encroach on mountain grounds blocking commoners from gathering firewood are punished.
translations.idiomatic: All princes, imperial sons-in-law, and powerful nobles who encroach on mountain grounds blocking commoners from gathering firewood shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 諸關譏不嚴，受財故縱者，罪之。

translations.literal: All pass inspections that are not strict and who accept bribes and deliberately release are punished.
translations.idiomatic: All pass inspections that are not strict and who accept bribes and deliberately release shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 諸江河津渡，或明知潮信已到，及風濤將起，貪索渡錢，淹延不渡，以致中流覆溺，傷害人命者，為首處死，為從減一等。

translations.literal: All at river fords or ferry crossings who clearly know the tide has arrived or storms are rising yet greedily demand ferry fees, delay without crossing, causing capsizing and drowning midstream and injury to life — principal put to death, followers reduced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: All at river fords or ferry crossings who clearly know the tide has arrived or storms are rising yet greedily demand ferry fees, delay without crossing, causing capsizing and drowning midstream and injury to life — the principal shall be put to death, followers reduced one grade.

sentences.zh: 諸棄俗出家，不從有司體覆，輒度為僧道者，其師笞五十七，受度者四十七，發元籍。

translations.literal: All who leave secular life without verification from officials and are rashly ordained as monks or Daoists — the master receives 57 lashes, the ordained 47 lashes, sent to original registration.
translations.idiomatic: All who leave secular life without verification from officials and are rashly ordained as monks or Daoists — the master shall receive 57 blows with the rod, the ordained 47 blows with the rod, and be sent back to their original registration.

sentences.zh: 諸以白衣善友為名，聚眾結社者，禁之。

translations.literal: All who under the name of lay Buddhist friends gather crowds and form societies are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All who under the name of lay Buddhist friends gather crowds and form societies are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸色目僧尼女冠，輒入民家強行抄化者，禁之。

translations.literal: All colored-category monks, nuns, and female Daoists who rashly enter commoners' homes and forcibly solicit alms are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All colored-category monks, nuns, and female Daoists who rashly enter commoners' homes and forcibly solicit alms are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸僧道偽造經文，犯上惑眾，為首者斬，為從者各以輕重論刑。

translations.literal: All monks and Daoists who forge scriptures, offend superiors and delude the masses — principals are beheaded, followers sentenced according to severity.
translations.idiomatic: All monks and Daoists who forge scriptures, offend superiors and delude the masses — principals shall be beheaded, followers sentenced according to severity.

sentences.zh: 諸以非理迎賽祈禱，惑眾亂民者，禁之。

translations.literal: All who without justification hold welcoming sacrifices and prayers, deluding the masses and disturbing the people are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All who without justification hold welcoming sacrifices and prayers, deluding the masses and disturbing the people are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸俗人集眾鳴鐃作佛事者，禁之。

translations.literal: All laypersons who gather crowds ringing cymbals to perform Buddhist rites are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All laypersons who gather crowds ringing cymbals to perform Buddhist rites are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸軍官鳩財聚眾，張設儀衛，鳴鑼擊鼓，迎賽神社，以為民倡者，笞五十七，其副二十七，並記過。

translations.literal: All military officers who extort funds, gather crowds, set up ritual guards, beat gongs and drums, and welcome and sacrifice at shrines as models for the people receive 57 lashes; deputies 27; all have offense noted.
translations.idiomatic: All military officers who extort funds, gather crowds, set up ritual guards, beat gongs and drums, and welcome and sacrifice at shrines as models for the people shall receive 57 blows with the rod; deputies 27 blows with the rod; all shall have the offense noted on their record.

sentences.zh: 諸陰陽家天文圖讖應禁之書，敢私藏者罪之。

translations.literal: All yin-yang masters' astronomical charts and prognostications — prohibited books privately hoarded are punished.
translations.idiomatic: All yin-yang masters' astronomical charts and prognostications — prohibited books privately hoarded shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 諸陰陽家偽造圖讖，釋老家私撰經文，凡以邪說左道誣民惑眾者，禁之，違者重罪之。

translations.literal: All yin-yang masters who forge prognostications, Daoist elders who privately compose scriptures, and all who with heterodox teachings and devious ways deceive and delude the people are forbidden; violators heavily punished.
translations.idiomatic: All yin-yang masters who forge prognostications, Daoist elders who privately compose scriptures, and all who with heterodox teachings and devious ways deceive and delude the people are forbidden; violators shall be heavily punished.

sentences.zh: 在寺觀者，罪及主守，居外者，所在有司察之。

translations.literal: Those in temples and monasteries — crime extends to custodians; those outside — local officials investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Those in temples and monasteries — crime extends to custodians; those outside — local officials shall investigate.

sentences.zh: 諸妄言禁書者，徒。

translations.literal: All who falsely speak of prohibited books receive penal servitude.
translations.idiomatic: All who falsely speak of prohibited books shall be sentenced to penal servitude.

sentences.zh: 諸陰陽家者流，輒為人燃燈祭星，蠱惑人心者，禁之。

translations.literal: All yin-yang practitioners who rashly light lamps and sacrifice to stars for people, bewitching hearts and minds are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All yin-yang practitioners who rashly light lamps and sacrifice to stars for people, bewitching hearts and minds are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸妄言星變災祥，杖一百七。

translations.literal: All who rashly speak of stellar changes and omens of disaster and blessing receive 107 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who rashly speak of stellar changes and omens of disaster and blessing shall receive 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸陰陽法師，輒入諸王公主駙馬家者，禁之。

translations.literal: All yin-yang masters who rashly enter princes', princesses', and imperial sons-in-law's households are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All yin-yang masters who rashly enter princes', princesses', and imperial sons-in-law's households are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸以陰陽相法書符咒水，凡異端之朮，惑亂人聽，希求仕進者，禁之，違者罪之。

translations.literal: All who with yin-yang physiognomy write talismans and charmed water, and all heterodox arts disturbing people's hearing and seeking advancement are forbidden; violators punished.
translations.idiomatic: All who with yin-yang physiognomy write talismans and charmed water, and all heterodox arts disturbing people's hearing and seeking advancement are forbidden; violators shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 諸寫匿名文書，所言重者處死，輕者流，沒其妻子，與捕獲人充賞。

translations.literal: All who write anonymous documents — if the words are grave, put to death; if light, exile; wives and children confiscated and given to captors as reward.
translations.idiomatic: All who write anonymous documents — if the words are grave, put to death; if light, exile; wives and children confiscated and given to captors as reward.

sentences.zh: 事主自獲者不賞。

translations.literal: If the target captures them personally, no reward.
translations.idiomatic: If the target captures them personally, no reward is given.

sentences.zh: 諸寫匿名文字，訐人私罪，不涉官事者，杖七十七。

translations.literal: All who write anonymous texts exposing others' private crimes not involving official matters receive 77 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who write anonymous texts exposing others' private crimes not involving official matters shall receive 77 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸投匿名文字於人家，脅取錢物者，杖八十七，發元籍。

translations.literal: All who deposit anonymous texts at people's homes to extort money receive 87 blows with the rod and are sent to original registration.
translations.idiomatic: All who deposit anonymous texts at people's homes to extort money shall receive 87 blows with the rod and be sent back to their original registration.

sentences.zh: 諸見匿名文書，非隨時敗獲者，即與燒毀；

translations.literal: All who find anonymous documents not captured at the time must burn them;
translations.idiomatic: All who find anonymous documents not captured at the time must burn them;

sentences.zh: 輒以聞官者，減犯人二等論罪。

translations.literal: those who rashly report to officials have the offender's crime reduced by two grades.
translations.idiomatic: those who rashly report to officials shall have the offender's crime reduced by two grades.

sentences.zh: 凡匿名文字，其言不及官府，止欲訐人罪者，如所訐論。

translations.literal: For all anonymous texts whose words do not involve the government and only wish to expose others' crimes, judge according to what is exposed.
translations.idiomatic: For all anonymous texts whose words do not involve the government and only wish to expose others' crimes, judgment follows what is exposed.

sentences.zh: 諸民間子弟，不務生業，輒於城市坊鎮演唱詞話，教習雜戲，聚眾淫謔，並禁治之。

translations.literal: All folk sons and younger brothers who do not pursue livelihood and rashly in city wards and market towns perform narrative songs, teach miscellaneous plays, gather crowds in lewd jest are all prohibited and corrected.
translations.idiomatic: All folk sons and younger brothers who do not pursue livelihood and rashly in city wards and market towns perform narrative songs, teach miscellaneous plays, and gather crowds in lewd jest are all prohibited and corrected.

sentences.zh: 諸弄禽蛇、傀儡，藏擫撇鈸、倒花錢、擊魚鼓，惑人集眾，以賣偽藥者，禁之，違者重罪之。

translations.literal: All who manipulate birds and snakes, puppets, hidden sleight-of-hand, inverted coin tricks, and fish-drum beating, deluding people and gathering crowds to sell fake medicine are forbidden; violators heavily punished.
translations.idiomatic: All who manipulate birds and snakes, puppets, hidden sleight-of-hand, inverted coin tricks, and fish-drum beating, deluding people and gathering crowds to sell fake medicine are forbidden; violators shall be heavily punished.

sentences.zh: 諸棄本逐末，習用角之戲，學攻刺之術者，師弟子並杖七十七。

translations.literal: All who abandon the root and pursue the branch, practice horn-goring games, and learn thrusting techniques — master and disciple each receive 77 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who abandon the root and pursue the branch, practice horn-goring games, and learn thrusting techniques — master and disciple shall each receive 77 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸亂制詞曲為譏議者，流。

translations.literal: All who disorderly compose song lyrics as satire receive exile.
translations.idiomatic: All who disorderly compose song lyrics as satire shall be exiled.

sentences.zh: 諸賭博錢物，杖七十七，錢物沒官，有官者罷見任，期年後雜職內敘。

translations.literal: All gambling for money receive 77 blows with the rod; money confiscated; officials dismissed from current post, after one year reinstated in miscellaneous ranks.
translations.idiomatic: All gambling for money shall receive 77 blows with the rod; money shall be confiscated; officials shall be dismissed from their current post and after one year reinstated in miscellaneous ranks.

sentences.zh: 開張博房之家，罪亦如之，再犯加徒一年。

translations.literal: Households opening gambling halls are punished the same; on second offense add one year penal servitude.
translations.idiomatic: Households opening gambling halls shall be punished the same; on a second offense, one year of penal servitude is added.

sentences.zh: 應捕故縱，笞四十七，受財者同罪。

translations.literal: Robber-catchers who deliberately release receive 47 lashes; if bribed, same crime.
translations.idiomatic: Robber-catchers who deliberately release shall receive 47 blows with the rod; if bribed, the same crime.

sentences.zh: 有司縱令攀指平人，及在前同賭人，罪及官吏。

translations.literal: If officials order implicating commoners and prior co-gamblers, crime extends to officials.
translations.idiomatic: If officials order implicating commoners and prior co-gamblers, crime extends to the officials.

sentences.zh: 賭飲食者，不坐。

translations.literal: Those who gamble for food and drink are not punished.
translations.idiomatic: Those who gamble for food and drink are not punished.

sentences.zh: 諸賭博錢物，同賭之人自首者，勿論。

translations.literal: All co-gamblers who confess voluntarily are not prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: All co-gamblers who confess voluntarily are not prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 諸賭博，因事發露，追到攤場，賭具贓證明白者，即以本法科論，不以展轉攀指革撥。

translations.literal: All gambling where exposure leads to the gambling site, with gambling tools and stolen goods evidence clear — sentence according to this law, not through extended implication and reform absolution.
translations.idiomatic: All gambling where exposure leads to the gambling site, with gambling tools and stolen goods evidence clear — sentence according to this law, not through extended implication and reform absolution.

sentences.zh: 諸故縱牛馬食踐田禾者，禁之。

translations.literal: All who deliberately allow cattle and horses to eat and trample field crops are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All who deliberately allow cattle and horses to eat and trample field crops are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸所在鎮守蒙古、漢軍，各立營所。

translations.literal: All local garrison Mongols and Han soldiers each establish camp sites.
translations.idiomatic: All local garrison Mongols and Han soldiers shall each establish camp sites.

sentences.zh: 無故輒入人家，求索酒食，及縱頭匹食踐田禾桑果，罪及主將。

translations.literal: Without cause rashly entering households seeking food and drink, or allowing livestock to eat and trample field crops and mulberry fruit — crime extends to commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Without cause rashly entering households seeking food and drink, or allowing livestock to eat and trample field crops and mulberry fruit — crime extends to the commanders.

sentences.zh: 諸藩王無都省文書，輒於各處征收差發，強取飲食草料，為民害者，禁之。

translations.literal: All princes without metropolitan office documents who at various places collect corvée and requisitions, forcibly taking food, drink, fodder, and grain harming the people are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All princes without metropolitan office documents who at various places collect corvée and requisitions, forcibly taking food, drink, fodder, and grain and harming the people are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸有虎豹為害之處，有司嚴勒官兵及打捕之人，多方捕之。

translations.literal: All places where tigers and leopards cause harm — officials strictly order soldiers and hunters to capture them by various means.
