translations.idiomatic: All places where tigers and leopards cause harm — officials shall strictly order soldiers and hunters to capture them by various means.

sentences.zh: 其中不應捕之人，自能設機捕獲者，皮肉不須納官，就以充賞。

translations.literal: Among them, persons not among those who should hunt who themselves can set traps and capture — hides and flesh need not be submitted to the state and may serve as reward.
translations.idiomatic: Among them, persons not among those who should hunt who themselves can set traps and capture — hides and flesh need not be submitted to the state and may serve as reward.

sentences.zh: 諸職官違例放鷹，追奪當日所服用鞍馬衣物沒官。

translations.literal: All officials who in violation release hawks — seize and confiscate that day's saddle, horse, clothing, and goods.
translations.idiomatic: All officials who in violation release hawks — that day's saddle, horse, clothing, and goods shall be seized and confiscated.

sentences.zh: 諸所撥各官圍獵山場，並毋禁民樵采，違者治之。

translations.literal: All hunting grounds assigned to various officials — commoners' firewood gathering is not forbidden; violators are corrected.
translations.idiomatic: All hunting grounds assigned to various officials — commoners' firewood gathering is not forbidden; violators shall be corrected.

sentences.zh: 諸年谷不登，人民愁困，諸王達官應出圍獵者，並禁止之。

translations.literal: All when the year's grain does not ripen and the people are distressed and impoverished — princes and high officials intending to go hunting are all forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All when the year's grain does not ripen and the people are distressed and impoverished — princes and high officials intending to go hunting are all forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸田禾未收，毋縱圍獵，於迤北不耕種之地圍獵者聽。

translations.literal: All before field crops are harvested, do not permit hunting encirclement; hunting in uncultivated northern lands is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: All before field crops are harvested, hunting encirclement is not permitted; hunting in uncultivated northern lands is permitted.

sentences.zh: 諸軍人受財，偽造火印，將所管官馬盜換與人者，杖九十七，追贓沒官。

translations.literal: All soldiers who accept bribes and forge fire brands to swap government horses they manage with others receive 97 blows with the rod; stolen goods recovered and confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: All soldiers who accept bribes and forge fire brands to swap government horses they manage with others shall receive 97 blows with the rod; stolen goods shall be recovered and confiscated.

sentences.zh: 諸年谷不登，百姓饑乏，遇禁地野獸，搏而食之者，毋輒沒入。

translations.literal: All when the year's grain does not ripen and the people are hungry and destitute, encountering wild beasts in forbidden grounds and capturing them for food — do not rashly confiscate.
translations.idiomatic: All when the year's grain does not ripen and the people are hungry and destitute, encountering wild beasts in forbidden grounds and capturing them for food — do not rashly confiscate.

sentences.zh: 諸打捕鷹坊官，以合進禦膳野物賣價自私者，計贓以枉法論，除名不敘。

translations.literal: All hawk-capture and falconry officials who privately sell at price wild game intended for the imperial table — calculating stolen value under perversion of law, struck from rolls without reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: All hawk-capture and falconry officials who privately sell at price wild game intended for the imperial table — calculating the stolen value under perversion of law, shall be struck from the rolls without reinstatement.

sentences.zh: 諸舟車之靡、器服之奇，方面大臣非錫貢不得擅進。

translations.literal: All boats and carriages' extravagance and utensils' oddity — regional grand ministers unless granted tribute may not without authorization present them.
translations.idiomatic: All boats and carriages' extravagance and utensils' oddity — regional grand ministers unless granted tribute may not without authorization present them.

sentences.zh: 諸闌遺人口到監，即移所稱籍貫，召主識認。

translations.literal: All stray persons arriving at prison — immediately transfer to claimed native registration and summon masters to identify.
translations.idiomatic: All stray persons arriving at prison — immediately transfer to claimed native registration and summon masters to identify.

sentences.zh: 半年之上無主識認者，匹配為戶，付有司當差。

translations.literal: If over half a year with no master identifying, assign as household and deliver to officials for corvée.
translations.idiomatic: If over half a year with no master identifying, assign as a household and deliver to officials for corvée.

sentences.zh: 殘疾老病，給以文引，而縱遣之。

translations.literal: Disabled, old, and ill — give travel documents and release.
translations.idiomatic: Disabled, old, and ill — give travel documents and release.

sentences.zh: 頭匹有主識認者，征還已有草料價錢，然後給主；

translations.literal: Horses and livestock with masters identifying — collect fodder price already paid then return to master;
translations.idiomatic: Horses and livestock with masters identifying — collect fodder price already paid, then return to the master;

sentences.zh: 無主識認，則籍其毛齒而收養之。

translations.literal: with no master identifying, register teeth and hair and keep them.
translations.idiomatic: with no master identifying, register teeth and hair and keep them.

sentences.zh: 諸闌遺奴婢，私相配合，雖生育子女，有主識認者，各歸其主，無本主者官與收系。

translations.literal: All stray slaves and servants who privately pair though bearing children — if masters identify, each returns to their master; with no original master officials collect and detain.
translations.idiomatic: All stray slaves and servants who privately pair though bearing children — if masters identify, each returns to their master; with no original master, officials collect and detain.

sentences.zh: 諸隱藏闌遺鷹犬者，笞三十七，沒其家財之半。

translations.literal: All who hide stray falcons and hounds receive 37 lashes and half their household property is confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: All who hide stray falcons and hounds shall receive 37 blows with the rod and half their household property shall be confiscated.

sentences.zh: 其收拾闌遺鷹犬之人，因以為民害者，罪之。

translations.literal: Those who collect stray falcons and hounds and thereby harm the people are punished.
translations.idiomatic: Those who collect stray falcons and hounds and thereby harm the people shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 諸鋤獲宿藏之物，在他人地內者，與地主中分，在官地內者一半納官，在己地內者即同業主。

translations.literal: All treasure dug up in another's land is split with the landowner; in government land half goes to the state; in one's own land same as the owner.
translations.idiomatic: All treasure dug up in another's land shall be split with the landowner; in government land half goes to the state; in one's own land, the finder keeps it as owner.

sentences.zh: 得古器珍寶之物者，聞官進獻，約量給價，若有詐偽隱匿，斷罪追沒。

translations.literal: Those obtaining ancient vessels and precious objects report to officials for presentation; approximate price given; if fraudulently concealing, sentence and recover.
translations.idiomatic: Those obtaining ancient vessels and precious objects shall report to officials for presentation; an approximate price shall be given; if fraudulently concealing, they shall be sentenced and the goods recovered.

sentences.zh: 諸監臨官輒舉貸於民者，取與俱罪之。

translations.literal: All supervising officials who rashly lend to the people — lender and borrower are both punished.
translations.idiomatic: All supervising officials who rashly lend to the people — lender and borrower shall both be punished.

sentences.zh: 諸稱貸錢谷，年月雖多，不過一本一息，有輒取贏於人，或轉換契券，息上加息，或占人牛馬財產，奪人子女以為奴婢者，重加之罪，仍償多取之息，其本息沒官。

translations.literal: All called loans of money and grain though many years pass may not exceed one principal and one interest; those who take profit from people, or convert contracts adding interest upon interest, or seize people's cattle, horses, property, or seize people's children as slaves — heavily add to the crime, still repay excess interest taken, principal and interest confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: All called loans of money and grain though many years pass may not exceed one principal and one interest; those who take profit from people, or convert contracts adding interest upon interest, or seize people's cattle, horses, property, or seize people's children as slaves — the crime shall be heavily increased, excess interest taken shall still be repaid, and principal and interest confiscated.

sentences.zh: 諸典質，不設正庫，不立信帖，違例取息者，禁之。

translations.literal: All pawn transactions without proper vaults and without credit notes, taking interest in violation are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All pawn transactions without proper vaults and without credit notes, taking interest in violation are forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸關廂店戶，居停各旅，非所知識，必問其所奉官府文引，但有可疑者，不得容止，違者罪之。

translations.literal: All inn and shop households lodging travelers — if not known acquaintances must ask what government office documents they carry; if anything suspicious may not lodge; violators punished.
translations.idiomatic: All inn and shop households lodging travelers — if not known acquaintances, must ask what government office documents they carry; if anything suspicious, may not lodge; violators shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 諸官戶行錢商船，輒豎旗號，置弓箭鑼鼓，揭錢主衙門職名，往來江河者，禁之。

translations.literal: All official households' money merchant boats rashly flying flags, setting bows and arrows, gongs and drums, displaying money masters' yamen titles traveling on rivers are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All official households' money merchant boats rashly flying flags, setting bows and arrows, gongs and drums, and displaying money masters' yamen titles traveling on rivers are forbidden.

sentences.zh: 諸經商及因事出外，必從有司會問鄰保，出給文引，違者究治。

translations.literal: All merchants and those going out on business must obtain neighborhood guarantee from officials and receive travel documents; violators investigated and corrected.
translations.idiomatic: All merchants and those going out on business must obtain neighborhood guarantee from officials and receive travel documents; violators shall be investigated and corrected.

sentences.zh: 諸投下並其餘有印信衙門，並不得濫給文引。

translations.literal: All appanages and other offices with seals may not recklessly issue travel documents.
translations.idiomatic: All appanages and other offices with seals may not recklessly issue travel documents.

sentences.zh: 諸有毒之藥，非醫人輒相賣買，致傷人命者，買者賣者皆處死。

translations.literal: All poisonous medicines — if not physicians rashly buy and sell causing injury to life, buyers and sellers are all put to death.
translations.idiomatic: All poisonous medicines — if not physicians rashly buy and sell causing injury to life, buyers and sellers shall all be put to death.

sentences.zh: 不曾傷人者，各杖六十七，仍追至元鈔一百兩，與告人充賞。

translations.literal: If not injuring persons, each receives 67 blows with the rod; still collect one hundred taels of Zhiyuan paper money for the accuser as reward.
translations.idiomatic: If not injuring persons, each shall receive 67 blows with the rod; one hundred taels of Zhiyuan paper money shall still be collected for the accuser as reward.

sentences.zh: 不通醫術，制合偽藥，於市井貸賣者，禁之。

translations.literal: Those without medical skill who compound fake medicine and sell in markets are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Those without medical skill who compound fake medicine and sell in markets are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸下海使臣及舶商，輒以中國生口、寶貨、戎器、馬匹遺外番者，從廉訪司察之。

translations.literal: All maritime envoys and merchant ships who rashly give Chinese persons, treasure goods, weapons, or horses to foreign countries are investigated by surveillance commissions.
translations.idiomatic: All maritime envoys and merchant ships who rashly give Chinese persons, treasure goods, weapons, or horses to foreign countries shall be investigated by surveillance commissions.

sentences.zh: 諸商賈收買金銀下番者，禁之，違者罪之。

translations.literal: All merchants who purchase gold and silver to take to foreign countries are forbidden; violators punished.
translations.idiomatic: All merchants who purchase gold and silver to take to foreign countries are forbidden; violators shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 諸海濱豪民，輒與番商交通貿易銅錢下海者，杖一百七。

translations.literal: All coastal powerful families who rashly trade with foreign merchants sending copper cash to sea receive 107 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All coastal powerful families who rashly trade with foreign merchants sending copper cash to sea shall receive 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸倡妓之家，所生男女，每季不過次月十日，會其數以上於中書省。

translations.literal: All courtesan establishments' born male and female each quarter by the tenth of the following month report their numbers to the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: All courtesan establishments' born male and female each quarter by the tenth of the following month shall report their numbers to the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 有未生墮其胎、已生輒殘其命者，禁之。

translations.literal: Those who abort before birth or after birth rashly destroy life are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Those who abort before birth or after birth rashly destroy life are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸倡妓之家，輒買良人為倡，而有司不審，濫給公據，稅務無憑，輒與印稅，並嚴禁之，違者痛繩之。

translations.literal: All courtesan establishments who rashly purchase commoners as courtesans while officials do not examine and recklessly issue public certificates, and tax offices without basis stamp tax — all strictly forbidden; violators severely punished.
translations.idiomatic: All courtesan establishments who rashly purchase commoners as courtesans while officials do not examine and recklessly issue public certificates, and tax offices without basis stamp tax — all strictly forbidden; violators shall be severely punished.

sentences.zh: ○雜犯

translations.literal: ○ Miscellaneous Offenses
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous Offenses

sentences.zh: 諸鬥爭折辨，輒提大名字者，罪之。

translations.literal: All who in disputes and arguments rashly invoke great names are punished.
translations.idiomatic: All who in disputes and arguments rashly invoke great names shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 諸職官因公失口亂言者，笞二十七。

translations.literal: All officials who on official business slip and speak disorderly words receive 27 lashes.
translations.idiomatic: All officials who on official business slip and speak disorderly words shall receive 27 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸快意中或酒後及害風狂疾，失口亂言，別無情理者，免罪。

translations.literal: All who in satisfaction, after wine, or with wind-sickness madness slip and speak disorderly words with no other reasoning are exempt from punishment.
translations.idiomatic: All who in satisfaction, after wine, or with wind-sickness madness slip and speak disorderly words with no other reasoning are exempt from punishment.

sentences.zh: 諸惡少無賴，結聚朋黨，陵轢善良，故行鬥爭，相與羅織者，與木偶連鎖，巡行街衢，得後犯人代之，然後決遣。

translations.literal: All wicked youths and ruffians who form gangs, oppress the good, deliberately fight, and mutually frame — chained to wooden puppets, paraded through streets; later offenders replace them, then sentence and dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: All wicked youths and ruffians who form gangs, oppress the good, deliberately fight, and mutually frame — chained to wooden puppets, paraded through streets; later offenders replace them, then they are sentenced and dispatched.

sentences.zh: 諸惡少白晝持刀劍於都市中，欲殺本部官長者，杖九十七。

translations.literal: All wicked youths who in daylight carry swords in the market wishing to kill their department chief receive 97 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All wicked youths who in daylight carry swords in the market wishing to kill their department chief shall receive 97 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸無賴軍人，輒受財毆人，因奪取錢物者，杖八十七，紅泥粉壁識過其門，免徒。

translations.literal: All ruffian soldiers who rashly accept bribes to beat people and thereby seize money receive 87 blows with the rod, red clay smeared on the wall to mark offense at their gate, exempt from penal servitude.
translations.idiomatic: All ruffian soldiers who rashly accept bribes to beat people and thereby seize money shall receive 87 blows with the rod, have red clay smeared on the wall to mark the offense at their gate, and be exempt from penal servitude.

sentences.zh: 諸先作過犯，曾經紅泥粉壁，後犯未應遷徙者，於元置紅泥粉壁添錄過名。

translations.literal: All who previously committed offenses and were marked with red clay on the wall, if later offending without requiring relocation — add the offense name to the original red clay wall marking.
translations.idiomatic: All who previously committed offenses and were marked with red clay on the wall, if later offending without requiring relocation — the offense name shall be added to the original red clay wall marking.

sentences.zh: 諸豪右權移官府，威行鄉井，淫暴貪虐，累犯不悛者，徙遠惡之地屯種。

translations.literal: All powerful persons who shift government authority, tyrannize villages, commit lewd violence, greed and cruelty, repeatedly offending without reform — exiled to distant evil lands for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: All powerful persons who shift government authority, tyrannize villages, commit lewd violence, greed and cruelty, and repeatedly offend without reform — shall be exiled to distant evil lands for garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 諸頻犯過惡，累斷不改者，流遠。

translations.literal: All who frequently commit offenses and evil, repeatedly sentenced without reform are exiled to distant regions.
translations.idiomatic: All who frequently commit offenses and evil, repeatedly sentenced without reform shall be exiled to distant regions.

sentences.zh: 諸凶人殘害良善，強將男子去勢，絕滅人後，幸獲生免者，杖一百七，流遠。

translations.literal: All vicious persons who harm the good, forcibly castrate men, extinguishing posterity, who fortunately survive receive 107 blows with the rod and exile to distant regions.
translations.idiomatic: All vicious persons who harm the good, forcibly castrate men, extinguishing posterity, who fortunately survive shall receive 107 blows with the rod and be exiled to distant regions.

sentences.zh: 諸貴勢之家，奴隸有犯，輒私置鐵枷，釘項禁錮，及擅刺其面者，禁之。

translations.literal: All noble and powerful households who privately set iron cangues, nail collars, and imprison slaves, and who without authorization tattoo their faces are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All noble and powerful households who privately set iron cangues, nail collars, and imprison slaves, and who without authorization tattoo their faces are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸獲逃奴，輒刺面劓鼻，非理殘苦者，禁之。

translations.literal: All who capture escaped slaves and rashly tattoo faces and cut noses with unreasonable cruelty are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: All who capture escaped slaves and rashly tattoo faces and cut noses with unreasonable cruelty are forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 諸無故擅刺其奴者，杖六十七。

translations.literal: All who without cause rashly tattoo their slaves receive 67 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All who without cause rashly tattoo their slaves shall receive 67 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 諸啰哩、回回為民害者，從所在有司禁治。

translations.literal: All Luo-li and Hui-hui who harm the people are prohibited and corrected by local officials.
translations.idiomatic: All Luo-li and Hui-hui who harm the people shall be prohibited and corrected by local officials.

sentences.zh: ○捕亡

translations.literal: ○ Capture of Fugitives
translations.idiomatic: Capture of Fugitives

sentences.zh: 諸失盜，捕盜官不立限捕盜，卻令他戶陪償事主財物者，罰俸兩月，仍立限追捕。

translations.literal: All theft losses where robber-capture officials do not set time limits for capture yet have other households compensate the victim's property — fine two months' salary, still set limits for pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: All theft losses where robber-capture officials do not set time limits for capture yet have other households compensate the victim's property — fine two months' salary, still set limits for pursuit.

sentences.zh: 諸強盜殺人，三限不獲，會赦，捕盜官合得罪罰革撥，仍令捕盜，任滿不獲，解由內通行開寫，依例黜降。

translations.literal: All robbers who kill people not captured within three limits — if amnesty applies, robber-capture officials receive deserved punishment and reform absolution, still ordered to capture; if term expires without capture, dismissal documents openly record, demoted according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: All robbers who kill people not captured within three limits — if an amnesty applies, robber-capture officials receive deserved punishment and reform absolution, still ordered to capture; if term expires without capture, dismissal documents openly record demotion according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 諸他境盜入境逃藏，捕盜官輒分彼疆此界，不即捕捉者，笞四十七，解職別敘，記過。

translations.literal: All robbers from other jurisdictions entering to hide — robber-capture officials who divide this territory from that and do not immediately capture receive 47 lashes, dismissed and reassigned elsewhere, notation of offense.
translations.idiomatic: All robbers from other jurisdictions entering to hide — robber-capture officials who divide this territory from that and do not immediately capture shall receive 47 blows with the rod, be dismissed and reassigned elsewhere, and have the offense noted on their record.

sentences.zh: 諸已斷流囚，在禁未發，反獄毆傷禁子，已逃復獲者，處死；

translations.literal: All already sentenced exiles in prison not yet dispatched who revolt in prison and beat and injure guards, if escaped and recaptured are put to death;
translations.idiomatic: All already sentenced exiles in prison not yet dispatched who revolt in prison and beat and injure guards, if escaped and recaptured shall be put to death;

sentences.zh: 未出禁者杖一百七，發已擬流所。

translations.literal: if not yet out of prison receive 107 blows with the rod and are sent to the already intended exile destination.
translations.idiomatic: if not yet out of prison shall receive 107 blows with the rod and be sent to the already intended exile destination.

sentences.zh: 諸解發囚徒，經過州縣止宿，不寄收牢房，輒於逆旅監系，以致脫監在逃者，長押官笞二十七，還役；

translations.literal: All escorting prisoners passing prefectures and counties stopping overnight not lodging in prison cells but rashly imprisoning at inns causing escape — chief escort official 27 lashes, restored to service;
translations.idiomatic: All escorting prisoners passing prefectures and counties stopping overnight not lodging in prison cells but rashly imprisoning at inns causing escape — chief escort official shall receive 27 blows with the rod and be restored to service;

sentences.zh: 防送官四十七，記過。

translations.literal: escort guard official 47 lashes, notation of offense.
translations.idiomatic: escort guard official shall receive 47 blows with the rod and have the offense noted on their record.

sentences.zh: 諸囚徒反獄而逃，主守減犯人罪二等，提牢官又減主守四等。

translations.literal: All prisoners who revolt in prison and escape — custodian reduced two grades from offender's crime; prison warden further reduced four grades from custodian.
translations.idiomatic: All prisoners who revolt in prison and escape — the custodian is reduced two grades from the offender's crime; the prison warden is further reduced four grades from the custodian.

sentences.zh: 隨時捉獲及半以上者，罰俸一月。

translations.literal: If promptly captured and half or more recovered, fine one month's salary.
translations.idiomatic: If promptly captured and half or more recovered, fine one month's salary.

sentences.zh: 諸奴婢背主而逃，杖七十七；

translations.literal: All slaves and servants who flee against their masters receive 77 blows with the rod;
translations.idiomatic: All slaves and servants who flee against their masters shall receive 77 blows with the rod;

sentences.zh: 誘引窩藏者，六十七。

translations.literal: those who entice, guide, and harbor receive 67 blows.
translations.idiomatic: those who entice, guide, and harbor shall receive 67 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: 鄰人、社長、坊里正知不首捕者，笞三十七；

translations.literal: Neighbors, community elders, and ward heads who know but do not report and capture receive 37 lashes;
translations.idiomatic: Neighbors, community elders, and ward heads who know but fail to report and capture shall receive 37 blows with the rod;

sentences.zh: 關譏應捕人受贓脫放者，以枉法論。

translations.literal: pass inspectors and robber-catchers who accept bribes and release are judged under perversion of law.
translations.idiomatic: pass inspectors and robber-catchers who accept bribes and release shall be judged under the law on perversion of law.

sentences.zh: 寺觀、軍營、勢家影蔽，及投下冒收為戶者，依藏匿論，自首者免罪。

translations.literal: Temples, monasteries, military camps, powerful households who conceal them, and appanages who falsely register them as households — judged as concealment; those who confess are exempt from punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Temples, monasteries, military camps, powerful households who conceal them, and appanages who falsely register them as households — judged as concealment; those who confess are exempt from punishment.

sentences.zh: 諸告獲逃奴者，於所將財物內，三分取一，付告獲人充賞。

translations.literal: All who report capture of escaped slaves — from goods they carry, one-third is taken and given to the captor as reward.
translations.idiomatic: All who report capture of escaped slaves — from goods they carry, one-third shall be taken and given to the captor as reward.

sentences.zh: 諸逃奴拒捕，不曾致傷人命者，仗一百七。

translations.literal: All escaped slaves who resist capture without causing injury to life receive 107 blows with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: All escaped slaves who resist capture without causing injury to life shall receive 107 blows with the rod.

sentences.zh: ○恤刑

translations.literal: ○ Lenient Punishment
translations.idiomatic: Lenient Punishment

sentences.zh: 諸獄囚，必輕重異處，男女異室，毋或參雜。

translations.literal: All prison inmates must be separated by severity, men and women in separate rooms, and must not be mixed.
translations.idiomatic: All prison inmates must be separated by severity, men and women in separate rooms, and must not be mixed.

sentences.zh: 司獄致其慎，獄卒去其虐，提牢官盡其誠。

translations.literal: Prison directors ensure their care, jailers remove their cruelty, and prison wardens exert their sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Prison directors shall ensure their care, jailers shall remove their cruelty, and prison wardens shall exert their sincerity.

sentences.zh: 諸在禁囚徒，無親屬供給，或有親屬而貧不能給者，日給倉米一升，三升之中，給粟一升，以食有疾者。

translations.literal: All imprisoned persons without relatives to supply them, or with relatives too poor to supply them, receive one sheng of granary rice daily; of three sheng, one sheng of millet for those with illness.
translations.idiomatic: All imprisoned persons without relatives to supply them, or with relatives too poor to supply them, shall receive one sheng of granary rice daily; of three sheng, one sheng of millet for those with illness.

sentences.zh: 凡油炭席薦之屬，各以時具。

translations.literal: All items such as oil, charcoal, mats, and cushions are provided seasonally.
translations.idiomatic: All items such as oil, charcoal, mats, and cushions shall be provided seasonally.

sentences.zh: 其饑寒而衣糧不繼，疾患而醫療不時，致非理死損者，坐有司罪。

translations.literal: If cold and hunger leave clothing and food unprovided, illness without timely medical supervision, failure to remove cangues and shackles, or not permitting relatives to attend — causing unreasonable death or injury, the responsible officials are punished.
translations.idiomatic: If cold and hunger leave clothing and food unprovided, illness without timely medical supervision, failure to remove cangues and shackles, or not permitting relatives to attend — causing unreasonable death or injury, the responsible officials shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 諸各處司獄司看守囚徒，夜支清油一斤。

translations.literal: All prison directorate offices guarding prisoners receive one jin of clear oil nightly.
translations.idiomatic: All prison directorate offices guarding prisoners shall receive one jin of clear oil nightly.

sentences.zh: 諸路府州縣，但停囚去處，於鼠耗糧內放支囚糧。

translations.literal: All circuits, prefectures, and counties wherever prisoners are held disburse prisoner grain from rodent-loss grain allowances.
translations.idiomatic: All circuits, prefectures, and counties wherever prisoners are held shall disburse prisoner grain from rodent-loss grain allowances.

sentences.zh: 諸在禁無家屬囚徒，歲十二月至於正月，給羊皮為披蓋，袴襪及薪草為暖匣熏炕之用。

translations.literal: All imprisoned persons without family in the twelfth month through the first month receive sheepskin cloaks, trousers and socks, and firewood and grass for warming boxes and heated kang beds.
translations.idiomatic: All imprisoned persons without family in the twelfth month through the first month shall receive sheepskin cloaks, trousers and socks, and firewood and grass for warming boxes and heated kang beds.

sentences.zh: 諸獄訟，有必聽候歸對之人，召保知在，如無保識，有司給糧養濟，勿寄養於民家。

translations.literal: All litigation where persons must await return for confrontation — summon guarantors knowing their whereabouts; if no guarantor is known, officials provide grain for support; do not lodge with commoner households.
translations.idiomatic: All litigation where persons must await return for confrontation — summon guarantors knowing their whereabouts; if no guarantor is known, officials shall provide grain for support; do not lodge with commoner households.

sentences.zh: 諸流囚在路，有司日給米一升，有疾命良醫治之，疾愈隨時發遣。

translations.literal: All exiles on the road — officials daily provide one sheng of rice; if ill order a good physician to treat; when illness heals dispatch promptly.
translations.idiomatic: All exiles on the road — officials shall daily provide one sheng of rice; if ill, order a good physician to treat; when illness heals, dispatch promptly.

sentences.zh: 諸獄醫，囚之司命，必試而後用之，若有弗稱，坐掌醫及提調官之罪。

translations.literal: All prison physicians, custodians of prisoners' lives, must be tested before use; if unfit, punish the supervising physician and adjusting officials.
translations.idiomatic: All prison physicians, custodians of prisoners' lives, must be tested before use; if unfit, the supervising physician and adjusting officials shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 諸獄囚病至二分，申報漸增至九分，為死證，若以重為輕，以急為緩，誤傷人命者，究之。

translations.literal: All imprisoned persons whose illness reaches two-tenths, reported gradually increasing to nine-tenths as death proof — if treating heavy as light or urgent as slow and mistakenly injuring life, investigate.
translations.idiomatic: All imprisoned persons whose illness reaches two-tenths, reported gradually increasing to nine-tenths as death proof — if treating heavy as light or urgent as slow and mistakenly injuring life, investigate.

sentences.zh: 諸獄囚有病，主司驗實，給醫藥，病重者去枷鎖杻，聽家人入侍。

translations.literal: All imprisoned persons who are ill — supervising office verifies truth, provides medicine; if gravely ill remove cangues and shackles and permit family to attend.
translations.idiomatic: All imprisoned persons who are ill — the supervising office shall verify the truth, provide medicine; if gravely ill, remove cangues and shackles and permit family to attend.

sentences.zh: 職事散官五品以上，聽二人入侍。

translations.literal: Functional and honorary officials of rank five and above may have two persons attend.
translations.idiomatic: Functional and honorary officials of rank five and above may have two persons attend.

sentences.zh: 犯惡逆以上，及強盜至死，奴婢殺主者，給醫藥而已。

translations.literal: Those committing treason and above, and robbers up to death, and slaves who kill masters — provide medicine only.
translations.idiomatic: Those committing treason and above, and robbers up to death, and slaves who kill masters — provide medicine only.

sentences.zh: 諸有司，在禁囚徒饑寒，衣食不時，病不督醫看候，不脫枷杻，不令親人入侍，一歲之內死至十人以上者，正官笞二十七，次官三十七，還職；

translations.literal: All officials where imprisoned persons suffer cold and hunger with untimely clothing and food, illness without supervised medical care, failure to remove cangues and shackles, or not permitting relatives to attend — if within one year deaths reach ten or more, regular chief 27 lashes, deputy 37 lashes, restored to office;
translations.idiomatic: All officials where imprisoned persons suffer cold and hunger with untimely clothing and food, illness without supervised medical care, failure to remove cangues and shackles, or not permitting relatives to attend — if within one year deaths reach ten or more, the regular chief shall receive 27 blows with the rod, the deputy 37 blows with the rod, and be restored to office;

sentences.zh: 首領官四十七，罷職別敘，記過。

translations.literal: chief clerks 47 lashes, dismissed and reassigned elsewhere, notation of offense.
translations.idiomatic: chief clerks shall receive 47 blows with the rod, be dismissed and reassigned elsewhere, and have the offense noted on their record.

sentences.zh: 諸孕婦有罪，產後百日決遣，臨產之月，聽令召保，產後二十日，復追入禁。

translations.literal: All pregnant women who commit crimes — after childbirth decide within one hundred days; in the month of delivery permit summoning guarantors; twenty days after childbirth again pursue into prison.
translations.idiomatic: All pregnant women who commit crimes — after childbirth decide within one hundred days; in the month of delivery, permit summoning guarantors; twenty days after childbirth, again pursue into prison.

sentences.zh: 無保及犯死罪者，產時令婦人入侍。

translations.literal: Those without guarantors and committing capital crimes — at delivery permit women to attend.
translations.idiomatic: Those without guarantors and committing capital crimes — at delivery, permit women to attend.

sentences.zh: 諸犯死罪，有親年七十以上，無兼丁侍養者，許陳請奏裁。

translations.literal: All who commit capital crimes with relatives aged seventy or above lacking another son to support — permitted to memorialize requesting imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: All who commit capital crimes with relatives aged seventy or above lacking another son to support — permitted to memorialize requesting imperial decision.

sentences.zh: 諸有罪年七十以上、十五以下，及篤廢殘疾罰贖者，每笞杖一，罰中統鈔一貫。

translations.literal: All who commit crimes aged seventy or above, fifteen or below, or gravely disabled and permitted commutation — for each lash or blow with the rod, commutation is one string of Zhongtong paper money.
translations.idiomatic: All who commit crimes aged seventy or above, fifteen or below, or gravely disabled and permitted commutation — for each lash or blow with the rod, commutation is one string of Zhongtong paper money.

sentences.zh: 諸疑獄，在禁五年之上不能明者，遇赦釋免。

translations.literal: All doubtful cases imprisoned five years or more without clarification — if amnesty applies, release and exempt.
translations.idiomatic: All doubtful cases imprisoned five years or more without clarification — if an amnesty applies, release and exempt.

sentences.zh: ○平反

translations.literal: ○ Rectification
translations.idiomatic: Rectification

sentences.zh: 諸官吏平反冤獄，應賞者，從有司保勘，廉訪司體覆，而後議之。

translations.literal: All officials and clerks who rectify wrongful convictions deserving reward — from officials' guarantee and investigation, surveillance commission verification, then deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: All officials and clerks who rectify wrongful convictions deserving reward — from officials' guarantee and investigation, surveillance commission verification, then deliberation.

sentences.zh: 其有冒濫不實者，罪及保勘體覆官吏。

translations.literal: If there is reckless inflation not true, crime extends to guarantee, investigation, and verification officials.
translations.idiomatic: If there is reckless inflation not true, crime extends to guarantee, investigation, and verification officials.

sentences.zh: 諸路府軍民長官，因收捕反叛，輒羅織平民，強奸室女，殺虜人口財產，並覆人之家，其同僚能理平民之冤，正犯人之罪，歸其俘虜，活其死命者，於本官上優升一等遷用。

translations.literal: All circuit, prefecture, military and civilian chiefs who in capturing rebels rashly frame commoners, forcibly violate maidens, kill and capture persons and property, and overturn households — colleagues who can rectify commoners' wrongs, correct offenders' crimes, return captives, and save lives are promoted one grade preferentially.
translations.idiomatic: All circuit, prefecture, military and civilian chiefs who in capturing rebels rashly frame commoners, forcibly violate maidens, kill and capture persons and property, and overturn households — colleagues who can rectify commoners' wrongs, correct offenders' crimes, return captives, and save lives shall be promoted one grade preferentially.

sentences.zh: 凡職官能平反重刑一起以上，升等同。

translations.literal: All functional officials who can rectify heavy sentences of one case or more are promoted one equivalent grade.
translations.idiomatic: All functional officials who can rectify heavy sentences of one case or more shall be promoted one equivalent grade.

sentences.zh: 諸職官能平反冤獄一起之上，與減一資。

translations.literal: All functional officials who can rectify wrongful convictions of one case or more receive reduction of one qualification.
translations.idiomatic: All functional officials who can rectify wrongful convictions of one case or more shall receive reduction of one qualification.

sentences.zh: 諸路府曹吏，能平反冤獄者，於各道宣慰司部令史補用。

translations.literal: All circuit and prefecture clerks who can rectify wrongful convictions are appointed as department clerks in the various Pacification Commission circuits.
translations.idiomatic: All circuit and prefecture clerks who can rectify wrongful convictions shall be appointed as department clerks in the various Pacification Commission circuits.
